CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD2_NTE
ON  R5NONCONFORMITYTYPEEMRS
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
   DECLARE @sUser             nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @nUpdatecount      int
   DECLARE @nOldUpdateCount   int
   DECLARE @nSqlIdentity      int

   IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      BEGIN
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         DECLARE c_ins_del
         CURSOR LOCAL FOR
         SELECT  I.NTE_UPDATECOUNT, D.NTE_UPDATECOUNT, I.NTE_SQLIDENTITY
         FROM    INSERTED I, DELETED D
         WHERE   I.NTE_SQLIDENTITY = D.NTE_SQLIDENTITY
         SET @sUser  = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         IF  @sUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
               OPEN  c_ins_del
               FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
               WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  BEGIN
                     IF ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
                        UPDATE R5NONCONFORMITYTYPEEMRS
                        SET    NTE_UPDATECOUNT = ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) + 1, NTE_LASTSAVED = getdate()
                        WHERE  NTE_SQLIDENTITY = @NSQLIDENTITY
                     ELSE
                        BEGIN
                           CLOSE c_ins_del
                           DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                           EXECUTE O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                           ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                           RETURN
                        END

                     FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
                  END
               CLOSE C_INS_DEL
            END
         DEALLOCATE C_INS_DEL
      END

create trigger PREUPD2_OBR
on R5OBJECTRISK
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nPk         		integer       
	declare @sObject     		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sObject_org 		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sClass      		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sClass_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sCategory   		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sRisk       		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @nRiskrev    		numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nRevision   		numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sRevrstatus 		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRevstatus  		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sCriticality		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @dCreated    		datetime            
	declare @sUser       		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dUpdated    		datetime            
	declare @sUpduser    		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @nOldPk         	integer       
	declare @sOldObject     	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldObject_org 	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldCategory   	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldRisk       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @nOldRiskrev    	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @nOldRevision   	numeric(4,0)        
	declare @sOldRevrstatus 	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRevstatus  	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldCriticality	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @sOldUpduser    	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.OBR_PK,	i.OBR_OBJECT,	i.OBR_OBJECT_ORG,	i.OBR_CLASS,	i.OBR_CLASS_ORG,
													  	i.OBR_CATEGORY,	i.OBR_RISK,	i.OBR_RISKREV,	i.OBR_REVISION,	i.OBR_REVRSTATUS,
													  	i.OBR_REVSTATUS,	i.OBR_CRITICALITY,	i.OBR_CREATED,	i.OBR_USER,	i.OBR_UPDATED,
													 	i.OBR_UPDUSER,	i.OBR_UPDATECOUNT,	i.OBR_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.OBR_PK,	d.OBR_OBJECT,	d.OBR_OBJECT_ORG,	d.OBR_CLASS,	d.OBR_CLASS_ORG,
													  	d.OBR_CATEGORY,	d.OBR_RISK,	d.OBR_RISKREV,	d.OBR_REVISION,	d.OBR_REVRSTATUS,
													  	d.OBR_REVSTATUS,	d.OBR_CRITICALITY,	d.OBR_CREATED,	d.OBR_USER,	d.OBR_UPDATED,
													  	d.OBR_UPDUSER,	d.OBR_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.OBR_SQLIDENTITY = d.OBR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nPk,	@sObject,	@sObject_org,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,
											@sCategory,	@sRisk,	@nRiskrev,	@nRevision,	@sRevrstatus,
											@sRevstatus,	@sCriticality,	@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,
											@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@nOldPk,	@sOldObject,	@sOldObject_org,	@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,
											@sOldCategory,	@sOldRisk,	@nOldRiskrev,	@nOldRevision,	@sOldRevrstatus,
											@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldCriticality,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,	@dOldUpdated,
											@sOldUpduser,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5OBJECTRISK set	OBR_PK           =  @nPk,	OBR_OBJECT       =  @sObject,	OBR_OBJECT_ORG   =  @sObject_org,
								            OBR_CLASS        =  @sClass,	OBR_CLASS_ORG    =  @sClass_org,	OBR_CATEGORY     =  @sCategory,
								            OBR_RISK         =  @sRisk,	OBR_RISKREV      =  @nRiskrev,	OBR_REVISION     =  @nRevision,
								            OBR_REVRSTATUS   =  @sRevrstatus,	OBR_REVSTATUS    =  @sRevstatus,	OBR_CRITICALITY  =  @sCriticality,
								            OBR_CREATED      =  @dCreated,	OBR_USER         =  @sUser,	OBR_UPDATED      =  @dUpdated,
								            OBR_UPDUSER      =  @sUpduser,	OBR_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, OBR_LASTSAVED =  @dUpdated
						where OBR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nPk,	@sObject,	@sObject_org,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,
													@sCategory,	@sRisk,	@nRiskrev,	@nRevision,	@sRevrstatus,
													@sRevstatus,	@sCriticality,	@dCreated,	@sUser,	@dUpdated,
													@sUpduser,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@nOldPk,	@sOldObject,	@sOldObject_org,	@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,
													@sOldCategory,	@sOldRisk,	@nOldRiskrev,	@nOldRevision,	@sOldRevrstatus,
													@sOldRevstatus,	@sOldCriticality,	@dOldCreated,	@sOldUser,	@dOldUpdated,
													@sOldUpduser,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sPagename, @sUsergroup
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5PAGELAYOUT set PLO_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, PLO_LASTSAVED = getdate() where PLO_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							set @sLocalPagename = @sPagename

							IF @sLocalPagename = N'BSDESC'
								  update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount where pgc_tabname=N'DES' AND pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_layouttype = N'W'
							ELSE
								begin
									IF @sLocalPagename=N'BSPARA'
										update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount where pgc_tabname=N'PAS'AND pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_layouttype = N'W'
									ELSE
										begin
											IF @sLocalPagename=N'BSADRS_ADR'
												update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount where pgc_tabname=N'ADR' AND pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_layouttype = N'W'
											ELSE
												begin
													set @nPos =charindex(N'_', @sLocalPagename)

													if( @nPos > 0)
														begin
															set @sFuncname = substring(@sLocalPagename,1,@nPos-1)
															set @sTabname = substring(@sLocalPagename,@nPos+1, len(@sLocalPagename))

															update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
															where pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_function=@sFuncname
															and pgc_tabname=@sTabname and pgc_layouttype = N'W'
														end
													else
													  update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
													  where pgc_usergroup=@sUsergroup and pgc_function=@sLocalPagename
													  and pgc_tabname =N'HDR' and pgc_layouttype = N'W'
												end
										end
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity,  @sPagename, @sUsergroup
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD2_POL
ON  R5POLICIES
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
   DECLARE @sUser             nvarchar(38)
   DECLARE @nUpdatecount      int
   DECLARE @nOldUpdateCount   int
   DECLARE @nSqlIdentity      int

   IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      BEGIN
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         DECLARE c_ins_del 
         CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
         SELECT  I.POL_UPDATECOUNT, D.POL_UPDATECOUNT, I.POL_SQLIDENTITY
         FROM    INSERTED I, DELETED D
         WHERE   I.POL_SQLIDENTITY = D.POL_SQLIDENTITY
         SET @sUser  = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         IF  @sUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
               OPEN  c_ins_del 
               FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
               WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                  BEGIN
                     IF ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
                        UPDATE R5POLICIES 
                        SET    POL_UPDATECOUNT = ISNULL( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) + 1, POL_LASTSAVED = getdate() 
                        WHERE  POL_SQLIDENTITY = @NSQLIDENTITY
                     ELSE
                        BEGIN
                           CLOSE c_ins_del
                           DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                           EXECUTE O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                           ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                           RETURN
                        END

                     FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del INTO @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
                  END
               CLOSE C_INS_DEL
            END
         DEALLOCATE C_INS_DEL
      END

create trigger PREUPD2_PRN
on R5PRINTERS
instead of update NOT FOR REPLICATION

as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nCode       		integer
	declare @sPrintertype		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sLpsuser    		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @nOldCode       	integer
	declare @sOldPrintertype	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldLpsuser    	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)   
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(38)

	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.PRN_CODE,	i.PRN_PRINTERTYPE,	i.PRN_DESC,	i.PRN_LPSUSER,	i.PRN_UPDATECOUNT,
													 	i.PRN_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.PRN_CODE,	d.PRN_PRINTERTYPE,	d.PRN_DESC,	d.PRN_LPSUSER,	d.PRN_UPDATECOUNT
													  
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.PRN_SQLIDENTITY = d.PRN_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nCode,	@sPrintertype,	@sDesc,	@sLpsuser,	@nUpdatecount,
										   	@nSqlidentity,
											@nOldCode,	@sOldPrintertype,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldLpsuser,	@nOldUpdatecount
										
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @sCode = cast(@nCode as nvarchar(38))

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'BARP', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5PRINTERS set	PRN_CODE         =  @nCode,	PRN_PRINTERTYPE  =  @sPrintertype,	PRN_DESC         =  @sDesc,
						                 	PRN_LPSUSER      =  @sLpsuser,	PRN_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, PRN_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						where PRN_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nCode,	@sPrintertype,	@sDesc,	@sLpsuser,	@nUpdatecount,
												   	@nSqlidentity,
													@nOldCode,	@sOldPrintertype,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldLpsuser,	@nOldUpdatecount
												
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_ROP2
on R5ROUTEPOINTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sRoute				nvarchar(20)
	declare @sObject			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjectOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sObrType			nvarchar(4)
	declare	@sObtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPoint				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPointType			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldRoute			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sOldObject			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldObjectOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldObrType		nvarchar(4)
	declare	@sOldObtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldPoint			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldPointType		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)
	declare @nReturn			int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.rop_route,i.rop_object, i.rop_object_org,i.rop_obrtype, i.rop_obtype, i.rop_point, i.rop_pointtype,
														d.rop_route,i.rop_object, d.rop_object_org,d.rop_obrtype, d.rop_obtype, d.rop_point, d.rop_pointtype,  
														i.ROP_UPDATECOUNT, d.ROP_UPDATECOUNT, i.ROP_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ROP_SQLIDENTITY = d.ROP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR() 
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sRoute, @sObject, @sObjectOrg, @sObrType, @sObtype,  @sPoint, @sPointType, 
						@sOldRoute, @sOldObject, @sOldObjectOrg, @sOldObrType, @sOldObtype,  @sOldPoint, @sOldPointType, 
						@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							IF @sRoute      <> @sOldRoute
							OR @sObject     <> @sOldObject
							OR @sObjectOrg <> @sOldObjectOrg
							OR @sObrType    <> @sOldObrType
							OR @sObtype     <> @sOldObtype
							OR @sPoint      <> @sOldPoint
							OR @sPointType  <> @sOldPointType 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return

create trigger PREUPD2_SCH
on r5schedules
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int

	declare @sCode       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sDescription	nvarchar(80)        

    declare @sCheckresult   nvarchar(4)
    declare @sX             nvarchar(1)
    declare @nReturn        int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.SCH_UPDATECOUNT, d.SCH_UPDATECOUNT, i.SCH_SQLIDENTITY, i.sch_code, i.sch_description
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.SCH_SQLIDENTITY = d.SCH_SQLIDENTITY

					open c_ins_del

									return

						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_SDM
on r5objectsdm
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser					nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount			int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount		int
	declare @nSqlIdentity			int
	declare @sObject				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldObject				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sObjectOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldObjectOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sMrc					nvarchar(15)
	declare @sProvider				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sProviderOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sServiceCategory		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sServiceCategoryOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @sServiceProblem		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sServiceProblemOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sMrcCheck				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sProviderCheck			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sServiceCategoryCheck	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sServiceProblemCheck	nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn				int
	declare @sInobjectupdate		nvarchar(10)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for
				select i.SDM_OBJECT, d.SDM_OBJECT, i.SDM_OBJECT_ORG,
					d.SDM_OBJECT_ORG, i.SDM_MRC, i.SDM_SUPPLIER,
					i.SDM_SUPPLIER_ORG, i.SDM_SERVICECATEGORY, i.SDM_SERVICECATEGORY_ORG,
					i.SDM_SERVICEPROBLEM, i.SDM_SERVICEPROBLEM_ORG, i.SDM_MRC_CHECK,
					i.SDM_SUPPLIER_CHECK, i.SDM_SERVICECATEGORY_CHECK, i.SDM_SERVICEPROBLEM_CHECK,
					i.SDM_UPDATECOUNT, d.SDM_UPDATECOUNT, i.SDM_SQLIDENTITY
				from inserted i, deleted d
				where i.SDM_SQLIDENTITY = d.SDM_SQLIDENTITY

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sObject, @sOldObject, @sObjectOrg,
									@sOldObjectOrg, @sMrc, @sProvider,
									@sProviderOrg, @sServiceCategory, @sServiceCategoryOrg,
									@sServiceProblem, @sServiceProblemOrg, @sMrcCheck,
									@sProviderCheck, @sServiceCategoryCheck, @sServiceProblemCheck,
									@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = dbo.O7DELKRF @sOldObject, @sOldObjectOrg
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update r5objectsdm set SDM_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, SDM_LASTSAVED = getdate() where SDM_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sObject, @sOldObject, @sObjectOrg,
											@sOldObjectOrg, @sMrc, @sProvider,
											@sProviderOrg, @sServiceCategory, @sServiceCategoryOrg,
											@sServiceProblem, @sServiceProblemOrg, @sMrcCheck,
											@sProviderCheck, @sServiceCategoryCheck, @sServiceProblemCheck,
											@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity

						end
					close c_ins_del
                    --poss_sdm code goes here since it is an after statement trigger
                    --I think the Oracle code intended to keep track of all of the rows 
                    --that were being updated in the loop above and then update them all here, 
                    --but that's not the way it is coded.  The wya it is actually coded, Oracle 
                    --only keeps track of the last row updated and runs this section of code
                    --against it here
					execute @nReturn = dbo.O7UPDKRF	@sObject, @sObjectOrg
					if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
						begin
							close c_ins_del
							deallocate c_ins_del
							rollback transaction
							return
						end
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_SFG
on R5SCREENFLOWGROUPS
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION

as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.SFG_UPDATECOUNT, d.SFG_UPDATECOUNT, i.SFG_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.SFG_SQLIDENTITY = d.SFG_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5SCREENFLOWGROUPS set SFG_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, SFG_LASTSAVED = getdate() where SFG_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

body:
create trigger PREUPD2_SHP
on R5SHFPERS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sShift				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sPerson			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldShift				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldPerson			nvarchar(15)
	declare @dShiftStart       		datetime
	declare @dShiftEnd       		datetime
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(2)
	declare @nCount				integer	
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)
	declare @nReturn		int	
	
	

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.SHP_SHIFT ,i.SHP_PERSON, d.SHP_SHIFT ,d.SHP_PERSON,i.SHP_START,i.SHP_END, i.SHP_UPDATECOUNT, d.SHP_UPDATECOUNT, i.SHP_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.SHP_SQLIDENTITY = d.SHP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sShift, @sPerson,@sOldShift, @sOldPerson,@dShiftStart,@dShiftEnd, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							if @sShift <> @sOldShift
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5SHFPERS set SHP_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, SHP_LASTSAVED = getdate() where SHP_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

/*DB start*/

									select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCSEP'
									if @nCount > 0
										select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCSEP'
									else
										set @sFlag = N'N'

									if @sFlag = N'Y'
										begin
											EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
											  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
											   XTS_TABLE,
											   XTS_KEYFLD1,
											   XTS_KEYFLD2,
											   XTS_KEYFLDDATE1,
											   XTS_KEYFLDDATE2,
											   XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID
											  )
											VALUES(
											  N'SYNCSHIFTEMP',
											  N'R5SHFPERS',
											  @sShift,
											  @sPerson,
											  @dShiftStart,
											  @dShiftEnd,
											  @sTempMsgid )
										end

/*DB end*/
								
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sShift, @sPerson,@sOldShift, @sOldPerson,@dShiftStart,@dShiftEnd, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_SNC
on R5SCREENCACHE
instead of update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sUser       		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sFunction   		nvarchar(6)         
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sOldFunction   	nvarchar(6)         
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.SNC_USER,	i.SNC_FUNCTION,	i.SNC_UPDATECOUNT,	i.SNC_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.SNC_USER,	d.SNC_FUNCTION,	d.SNC_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.SNC_SQLIDENTITY = d.SNC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sUser,	@sFunction,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldUser,	@sOldFunction,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end
					update R5SCREENCACHE set	SNC_USER         =  @sUser,	SNC_FUNCTION     =  @sFunction,	SNC_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, SNC_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						                    
						where SNC_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sUser,	@sFunction,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldUser,	@sOldFunction,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD2_TKA
on R5TOPKBARTICLES
instead of update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sKbarticle      		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sKbarticle_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sLang           		nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sKbarticle_title		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @nSearchcount    		numeric(8,0)        
	declare @nRanking        		numeric(3,0)        
	declare @nUpdatecount    		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity    		integer             

	declare @sOldKbarticle      	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldKbarticle_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @sOldLang           	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sOldKbarticle_title	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @nOldSearchcount    	numeric(8,0)        
	declare @nOldRanking        	numeric(3,0)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount    	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.TKA_KBARTICLE,	i.TKA_KBARTICLE_ORG,	i.TKA_LANG,	i.TKA_KBARTICLE_TITLE,	i.TKA_SEARCHCOUNT,
													 	i.TKA_RANKING,	i.TKA_UPDATECOUNT,	i.TKA_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.TKA_KBARTICLE,	d.TKA_KBARTICLE_ORG,	d.TKA_LANG,	d.TKA_KBARTICLE_TITLE,	d.TKA_SEARCHCOUNT,
													  	d.TKA_RANKING,	d.TKA_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.TKA_SQLIDENTITY = d.TKA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sKbarticle,	@sKbarticle_org,	@sLang,	@sKbarticle_title,	@nSearchcount,
										   	@nRanking,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldKbarticle,	@sOldKbarticle_org,	@sOldLang,	@sOldKbarticle_title,	@nOldSearchcount,
											@nOldRanking,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5TOPKBARTICLES set	TKA_KBARTICLE        =  @sKbarticle,	TKA_KBARTICLE_ORG    =  @sKbarticle_org,	TKA_LANG             =  @sLang,
						                      	TKA_KBARTICLE_TITLE  =  @sKbarticle_title,	TKA_SEARCHCOUNT      =  @nSearchcount,	TKA_RANKING          =  @nRanking,
						                      	TKA_UPDATECOUNT      =  @nUpdatecount,		TKA_LASTSAVED        =  getdate()
						where TKA_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sKbarticle,	@sKbarticle_org,	@sLang,	@sKbarticle_title,	@nSearchcount,
												   	@nRanking,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldKbarticle,	@sOldKbarticle_org,	@sOldLang,	@sOldKbarticle_title,	@nOldSearchcount,
													@nOldRanking,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

on R5WSMSGPARTS
instead of update

	declare @sMessage       		nvarchar(60)        
	declare @sPart          		nvarchar(60)        
	declare @dTime          		datetime            
	declare @sStatus        		nvarchar(4)

	declare @nUpdatecount   		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity   		integer

	declare @sOldPart          	nvarchar(60)

	declare @sOldStatus        	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRstatus       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldStatus_message	nvarchar(1000)      
	declare @nOldUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.WSP_MESSAGE,	i.WSP_PART,	i.WSP_TIME,	i.WSP_STATUS,
													 	i.WSP_RSTATUS,	i.WSP_STATUS_MESSAGE,	i.WSP_UPDATECOUNT,	i.WSP_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.WSP_MESSAGE,	d.WSP_PART,	d.WSP_TIME,	d.WSP_STATUS,
													  	d.WSP_RSTATUS,	d.WSP_STATUS_MESSAGE,	d.WSP_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.WSP_SQLIDENTITY = d.WSP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del

											@sOldMessage,	@sOldPart,	@dOldTime,	@sOldStatus,
											@sOldRstatus,	@sOldStatus_message,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin

									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR

					where w.WSP_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity
					and w.WSP_SQLIDENTITY = i.WSP_SQLIDENTITY

													@sOldRstatus,	@sOldStatus_message,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD3_PRQ
on R5PRODUCTIONREQUESTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
   declare @sUser               nvarchar(38)
   declare @sStatus             nvarchar(4)
   declare @sOldstatus          nvarchar(4)
   declare @dLastStatusUpdate   datetime
   declare @nSqlIdentity        int
   declare @dCreated            datetime
   declare @sOrg                nvarchar(15)


   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.prq_status, d.prq_status, i.prq_laststatusupdate, d.prq_created, i.prq_org, i.prq_sqlidentity
                                            from   inserted i, deleted d
                                            where  i.prq_sqlidentity = d.prq_sqlidentity
         set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         if @sUser <> N'SYS'
         begin
            open c_ins_del
            fetch next from c_ins_del into @sStatus, @sOldstatus, @dLastStatusUpdate, @dCreated, @sOrg, @nSqlIdentity
            while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
               begin

                  if @sStatus <> @sOldstatus
                     begin
                        set @dLastStatusUpdate = dbo.o7gttime2( @sOrg )
                     end
                  if @dLastStatusUpdate is null
                     begin
               	      set @dLastStatusUpdate = @dCreated
                     end
                  update r5productionrequests
                  set    prq_laststatusupdate = @dLastStatusUpdate
                  where  prq_sqlidentity      = @nSqlIdentity

                  fetch next from c_ins_del into @sStatus, @sOldstatus, @dLastStatusUpdate, @dCreated, @sOrg, @nSqlIdentity
               end
            close c_ins_del
         end
         deallocate c_ins_del
      end

					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							-- preupd_acc portion
							/* A08212 : Code not updateable */
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End
							/* A08221 : Class must exist ( r5classes, rentity = 'ACCO' ) */
							If @sClass is not null 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'ACCO', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_ACC', N'TRIG', 1, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
									else
										if @nCountit < 0 
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7RAE N'O7EXIST', N'PROC', 1, @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return

											end
								end

							update R5ACTIONCODES set ACC_UPDATED = GetDate() where ACC_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--PREUPD2_ACC portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5ACTIONCODES set ACC_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where ACC_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSUPD_ACC portion
						   /* A0824 Update r5descriptions */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'ACCO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, null, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_ACP
on R5PERIODS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nSeqno				numeric(2)
	declare @sPeriod			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sYear				nvarchar(8)
	declare @nOldSeqno			numeric(2)
	declare @sOldPeriod			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldYear			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sInuse				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCount				int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ACP_SEQNO, i.ACP_PERIOD, i.ACP_YEAR, i.ACP_UPDATECOUNT, d.ACP_SEQNO, d.ACP_PERIOD, d.ACP_YEAR, d.ACP_UPDATECOUNT, i.ACP_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ACP_SQLIDENTITY = d.ACP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nSeqno,@sPeriod,@sYear,@nUpdatecount,@nOldSeqno,@sOldPeriod,@sOldYear,@nOldUpdateCount,@nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin


							IF @nSeqno <> @nOldSeqno
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							select @nCount = count(*)
							FROM   r5budgetdetails
							WHERE  bdt_year = @sOldYear

							if @nCount = 1 
								SELECT @sInuse = N'Y'
								FROM   r5budgetdetails
								WHERE  bdt_year = @sOldYear
							else
								if @nCount > 1
									set  @sInuse = N'Y'
								else
									set  @sInuse = NULL


							IF @sInuse = N'Y' 
								begin
									IF @sPeriod <> @sOldPeriod
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5PERIODS set ACP_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, ACP_LASTSAVED = getdate() where ACP_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nSeqno,@sPeriod,@sYear,@nUpdatecount,@nOldSeqno,@sOldPeriod,@sOldYear,@nOldUpdateCount,@nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_ACT2
ON r5firstact
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT act_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5firstact
          SET    act_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  act_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

	declare @sYear				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)

	declare @dOldStart			datetime
	declare @dEnd				datetime
	declare @dOldEnd			datetime
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ACY_YEAR, i.ACY_ORG,  i.ACY_DESC, i.ACY_CAL, i.ACY_START, i.ACY_END, i.ACY_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.ACY_CAL, d.ACY_START, d.ACY_END , d.ACY_UPDATECOUNT, i.ACY_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ACY_SQLIDENTITY = d.ACY_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sYear, @sOrg,@sDesc,@sCal, @dStart, @dEnd, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCal, @dOldStart, @dOldEnd, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							-- preupd_ACY portion
							/* A08212 : Code not updateable */
							IF @sCal <> @sOldCal OR @dStart <> @dOldStart OR @dEnd <> @dOldEnd
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End


							--PREUPD2_ACY portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5YEARS set ACY_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, ACY_LASTSAVED = getdate() where ACY_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							--POSUPD_ACY portion
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'YEAR', @sX, N'*', @sYear, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sYear, @sOrg,@sDesc,@sCal, @dStart, @dEnd, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCal, @dOldStart, @dOldEnd, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_ADD
on R5ADDETAILS
instead of update
as
   declare @sSysUser          nvarchar(38)
   declare @sEntity           nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sRentity          nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sType             nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sRtype            nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sCode             nvarchar(100)       
   declare @sLang             nvarchar(2)         
   declare @nLine             numeric(12,0)        
   declare @sPrint            nvarchar(1)         
   declare @dCreated          datetime            
   declare @sUser             nvarchar(255)       
   declare @dUpdated          datetime            
   declare @sUpduser          nvarchar(255)       
   declare @nUpdatecount      numeric(38,0)       
   declare @nSqlidentity      integer             

   declare @sOldEntity        nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sOldRentity       nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sOldType          nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sOldRtype         nvarchar(4)         
   declare @sOldCode          nvarchar(100)       
   declare @sOldLang          nvarchar(2)         
   declare @nOldLine          numeric(12,0)        
   declare @sOldPrint         nvarchar(1)         
   declare @dOldCreated       datetime            
   declare @sOldUser          nvarchar(255)       
   declare @dOldUpdated       datetime            
   declare @sOldUpduser       nvarchar(255)       
   declare @nOldUpdatecount   numeric(38,0)       

   declare @nCount            int
   declare  @sFlag            nvarchar(2)
   declare @nReturn           int
   declare @dGetdate          datetime
   declare @sSQL              nvarchar(500)
   declare @sPevEvent         nvarchar(30)
   declare @sSessuser         nvarchar(255)     

   declare @sInobjectupdate   nvarchar(10)
   declare @sForgetme         nvarchar(10)

   if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
      begin
         SET NOCOUNT ON
         EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
         EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INFORGETME @sForgetme OUTPUT
         declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ADD_ENTITY,  i.ADD_RENTITY, i.ADD_TYPE, i.ADD_RTYPE,   i.ADD_CODE,
                                          i.ADD_LANG, i.ADD_LINE, i.ADD_PRINT,   i.ADD_CREATED,
                                          i.ADD_USER, i.ADD_UPDATED, i.ADD_UPDUSER, i.ADD_UPDATECOUNT,   i.ADD_SQLIDENTITY
                                        ,
                                          d.ADD_ENTITY,  d.ADD_RENTITY, d.ADD_TYPE, d.ADD_RTYPE,   d.ADD_CODE,
                                          d.ADD_LANG, d.ADD_LINE, d.ADD_PRINT,   d.ADD_CREATED,
                                          d.ADD_USER, d.ADD_UPDATED, d.ADD_UPDUSER, d.ADD_UPDATECOUNT
                                       from inserted i, deleted d
                                       where i.ADD_SQLIDENTITY = d.ADD_SQLIDENTITY
         set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
         open c_ins_del
         fetch next from c_ins_del into   @sEntity,   @sRentity,  @sType,  @sRtype, @sCode,
                                    @sLang,  @nLine,  @sPrint, @dCreated,
                                    @sUser,  @dUpdated,  @sUpduser,  @nUpdatecount, @nSqlidentity
                                 ,
                                 @sOldEntity,   @sOldRentity,  @sOldType,  @sOldRtype, @sOldCode,
                                 @sOldLang,  @nOldLine,  @sOldPrint, @dOldCreated,
                                 @sOldUser,  @dOldUpdated,  @sOldUpduser,  @nOldUpdatecount
         while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
            begin
               if @sSysUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE' and @sForgetme = N'FALSE' 
                  begin
                            --PREUPD_ADD portion
                            if @sCode  <> @sOldCode      OR
                             @sRentity <> @sOldRentity      OR
                             @sType    <> @sOldType
                               begin
                                  if @sOldRentity IN ( N'PART', N'CATL', N'FBIL', N'STOC', N'PERS' ) 
                                     begin
                                        if @sRentity  <> @sOldRentity   OR
                                         @sType       <> @sOldType   OR
                                         @sLang       <> @sOldLang

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_ADR
ON r5address
FOR UPDATE 
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS 
BEGIN
	DECLARE @sUser			NVARCHAR(38)
	DECLARE @sCheckresult	NVARCHAR(4)

	-- Variables for the Old Record Values
	DECLARE @sOldRentity	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sOldCode		NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @sOldRType		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @nOldUpdCount	INT
	DECLARE @iOldSQLIdent	INT

	-- Variables for the New Record Values
	DECLARE @sNewRentity		NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sNewCode			NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @sNewRType			NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @nNewUpdCount		INT
	DECLARE @sInobjectupdate	NVARCHAR(10)
	DECLARE @nReturn			INT

	-- If no records updated then bypass trigger processing
	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			-- If User is SYS then bypass trigger processing
			SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			IF @sUser <> N'SYS' AND @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				BEGIN
				-- Cursor Declaration
					DECLARE c_Upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR 
						SELECT 	i.adr_rentity, 		d.adr_rentity,
								i.adr_code,			d.adr_code,
								i.adr_rtype,		d.adr_rtype,
								i.adr_updatecount,	d.adr_updatecount,
								i.adr_sqlidentity
						FROM 	inserted i, deleted d
						WHERE	i.adr_sqlidentity = d.adr_sqlidentity
					
					-- Open Cursor
					OPEN c_Upd
					
					FETCH NEXT 
					FROM	c_Upd 
					INTO	@sNewRentity,   @sOldRentity,
							@sNewCode,      @sOldCode,
							@sNewRType,     @sOldRType,
							@nNewUpdCount,  @nOldUpdCount,
							@iOldSQLIdent
					
					-- Process Each Updated Row
					WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						BEGIN
							-- Check if ADR_RENTITY, ADR_CODE or ADR_RTYPE has been changed
							IF (@sOldRentity <> @sNewRentity) OR
								(@sOldCode <> @sNewCode AND @sNewRentity <> N'PERS') OR
								(@sOldRType <> @sNewRType)
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_Upd
									DEALLOCATE c_Upd
									EXECUTE O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 3
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN									
								END
							
							-- Increment the UpdateCount field
							if isnull( @nNewUpdCount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdCount, -1 )
								update r5address set adr_updatecount = isnull( @nNewUpdCount, -1) + 1, ADR_LASTSAVED = getdate() where adr_sqlidentity		= @iOldSQLIdent
							else
								begin
									close c_Upd
									deallocate c_Upd
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							
							FETCH NEXT 
							FROM	c_Upd 
							INTO	@sNewRentity,   @sOldRentity,
							        @sNewCode,      @sOldCode,
							        @sNewRType,     @sOldRType,
							        @nNewUpdCount,  @nOldUpdCount,
							        @iOldSQLIdent
						END
					CLOSE c_Upd
					DEALLOCATE c_Upd
				END
		END
END

create trigger PREUPD_AOR
on R5ARCORDERS
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldCode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.AOR_CODE, i.AOR_DESC, d.AOR_CODE, i.AOR_SQLIDENTITY 
													from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.AOR_SQLIDENTITY = d.AOR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							If @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'AORD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							update r5arcorders
							set    aor_lastsaved = getdate()
							where  aor_sqlidentity = @nSqlIdentity

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_APR
on R5ADDPROPERTIES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
    declare @sUser              nvarchar(38)
    declare @sProperty          nvarchar(8)
    declare @sRentity           nvarchar(4)
    declare @sClass             nvarchar(8)
    declare @sClassOrg          nvarchar(15)
    declare @sUom               nvarchar(30)
    declare @sList              nchar(1)
	declare @sGroupLabel         nvarchar(255)
    declare @sOldProperty       nvarchar(8)
    declare @sOldRentity        nvarchar(4)
    declare @sOldClass          nvarchar(8)
    declare @sOldClassOrg       nvarchar(15)
    declare @sOldList           nchar(1)
	declare @sOldGroupLabel      nvarchar(255)
    declare @nUpdatecount       int
    declare @nOldUpdatecount    int
    declare @nSqlIdentity       int
    declare @nReturn            int
    declare @sCode              nvarchar(100)
    declare @sCheckresult	    nvarchar(4)

    if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
        begin
            SET NOCOUNT ON
            declare c_ins_del cursor local for select   i.APR_PROPERTY, i.APR_RENTITY, i.APR_CLASS, i.APR_CLASS_ORG, i.APR_UOM, i.APR_LIST, i.APR_GROUPLABEL,
                                                        d.APR_PROPERTY, d.APR_RENTITY, d.APR_CLASS, d.APR_CLASS_ORG, d.APR_LIST, d.APR_GROUPLABEL,
                                                        i.APR_UPDATECOUNT, d.APR_UPDATECOUNT, i.APR_SQLIDENTITY
                                                   from inserted i, deleted d
                                                  where i.APR_SQLIDENTITY = d.APR_SQLIDENTITY
            set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
            if @sUser <> N'SYS'
                begin
                    open c_ins_del
                    fetch next from c_ins_del into @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sUom, @sList, @sGroupLabel, @sOldProperty, @sOldRentity, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldList, @sOldGroupLabel, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
                    while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
                        begin
                            --PREUPD_APR portion
                            if @sProperty <> @sOldProperty OR @sRentity <> @sOldRentity OR @sClass <> @sOldClass
                                begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end
                            if @sList <> @sOldList and @sOldList <> N'-'
                                begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_APR', N'TRIG', 1
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end
                            execute @nReturn = O7PROP_PREAPR N'UPD', @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sUom, @sList
                            if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
                                begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end

                            update R5ADDPROPERTIES set APR_UPDATED = GetDate() where APR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

                            --PREUPD2_APR portion
                            if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
                                update R5ADDPROPERTIES set APR_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where APR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
                            else
                                begin
                                    close c_ins_del
                                    deallocate c_ins_del
                                    execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                                    rollback transaction
                                    return
                                end


                                --Update pagecache for both list and record view.
                                update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                                where pgc_rentity=@sOldRentity
                                and pgc_tabname in(N'HDR',N'LST')

                                /* If handling PART , OBJ or EVNT entity, then translate to PEVL or EEVL or PPM respectively */
                                /* SSEVAL shows PART custom fields , OSEVAL shows OBJ custom fields and WSPPMS shows EVNT custom fields */
                                if( @sOldRentity = 'PART' OR @sOldRentity = 'OBJ' )
                                   begin
                                      update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                                         where pgc_rentity= CASE @sOldRentity 
                                         			WHEN 'PART' THEN 'PEVL'
                                         			ELSE 'EEVL' END
                                         and pgc_tabname in (N'HDR',N'LST')
                                   end

                                if( @sRentity = 'EVNT' )
                                   begin
                                      update r5pagecache set pgc_updatecount=pgc_updatecount
                                         where pgc_rentity in ( N'PPM', N'STWO' )
                                         and pgc_tabname in (N'HDR',N'LST')
                                   end

							-- Updating group label translations
							set @sCode = @sProperty + '#' + @sRentity + '#' + @sClass + '#' + @sClassOrg
							if @sOldGroupLabel IS NOT NULL and @sGroupLabel IS NULL
							  begin
							    execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'DEL', NULL, N'CFGL', NULL, N'*', @sCode, NULL, NULL, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								  begin
								    close c_deleted
									deallocate c_deleted
									rollback transaction
									return
								  end
							  end
							else if @sOldGroupLabel IS NULL AND @sGroupLabel IS NOT NULL
							  begin
							    execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'INS', NULL, N'CFGL', NULL, N'*', @sCode, NULL, @sGroupLabel, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
						        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
							      begin
								    close c_inserted
								    deallocate c_inserted
								    rollback transaction
								    return
								  end
							  end
							else if @sOldGroupLabel IS NOT NULL AND @sGroupLabel IS NOT NULL AND @sGroupLabel <> @sOldGroupLabel
							  begin
								execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', NULL, N'CFGL', NULL, N'*', @sCode, NULL, @sGroupLabel, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								  begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								  end
							  end

                            fetch next from c_ins_del into @sProperty, @sRentity, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sUom, @sList, @sGroupLabel, @sOldProperty, @sOldRentity, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldList, @sOldGroupLabel, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity

                end

create trigger PREUPD_ASP
on R5ASPECTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ASP_CODE, i.ASP_DESC, i.ASP_CLASS, i.ASP_CLASS_ORG , i.ASP_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.ASP_CODE, d.ASP_DESC, d.ASP_CLASS, d.ASP_CLASS_ORG , d.ASP_UPDATECOUNT, i.ASP_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ASP_SQLIDENTITY = d.ASP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end


								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'ASPC', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_ASP', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							update R5ASPECTS set ASP_UPDATED = GetDate() where ASP_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--PREUPD2_ASP portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5ASPECTS set ASP_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where ASP_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'ASPC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (coalesce(@sOldClass,N'*')  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg) <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'ASPC'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_AUT
on R5AUTH
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sAutGroup			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sAutUser			nvarchar(255)
	declare @sAutEntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAutRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAutStatus			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAutStatnew		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldAutGroup		nvarchar(12)
	declare @sOldAutUser		nvarchar(255)
	declare @sOldAutEntity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldAutRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldAutStatus		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldAutStatnew		nvarchar(4)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sForgetme              nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			execute O7SESS_CUR_INFORGETME @sForgetme OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.AUT_GROUP, i.AUT_USER, i.AUT_ENTITY, i.AUT_RENTITY,
														i.AUT_STATUS, i.AUT_STATNEW, d.AUT_GROUP, d.AUT_USER, 
														d.AUT_ENTITY, d.AUT_RENTITY, d.AUT_STATUS, d.AUT_STATNEW,
														i.AUT_UPDATECOUNT, d.AUT_UPDATECOUNT, i.AUT_SQLIDENTITY
												from	inserted i, deleted d
												where	i.AUT_SQLIDENTITY = d.AUT_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sForgetme <> N'TRUE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sAutGroup, @sAutUser, @sAutEntity, @sAutRentity, @sAutStatus, @sAutStatnew,
													@sOldAutGroup, @sOldAutUser, @sOldAutEntity, @sOldAutRentity, @sOldAutStatus, @sOldAutStatnew, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sAutGroup	<> @sOldAutGroup	OR
							  @sAutUser		<> @sOldAutUser		OR
							  @sAutEntity	<> @sOldAutEntity	OR
							  @sAutRentity	<> @sOldAutRentity	OR
							  @sAutStatus	<> @sOldAutStatus	OR
							  @sAutStatnew	<> @sOldAutStatnew
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update	R5AUTH set AUT_UPDATED = GetDate()
							 where	AUT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--PREUPD2_AUT portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update	R5AUTH set AUT_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
								 where	AUT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sAutGroup, @sAutUser, @sAutEntity, @sAutRentity, @sAutStatus, @sAutStatnew,
															@sOldAutGroup, @sOldAutUser, @sOldAutEntity, @sOldAutRentity, @sOldAutStatus, @sOldAutStatnew, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_BGR
on R5BUDGETGROUPS
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(5)         
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sEntity     		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRentity    		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(5)         
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldEntity     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRentity    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.BGR_CODE,	i.BGR_DESC,	i.BGR_ENTITY,	i.BGR_RENTITY,	i.BGR_ORG,
													 	i.BGR_UPDATECOUNT,	i.BGR_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.BGR_CODE,	d.BGR_DESC,	d.BGR_ENTITY,	d.BGR_RENTITY,	d.BGR_ORG,
													  	d.BGR_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.BGR_SQLIDENTITY = d.BGR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sOrg,
											@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldEntity,	@sOldRentity,	@sOldOrg,
											@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX           = NULL

							if @sRentity <> @sOldRentity OR  @sEntity <> @sOldEntity
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


   							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'BUGR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end

					update R5BUDGETGROUPS set	BGR_CODE         =  @sCode,	BGR_DESC         =  @sDesc,	BGR_ENTITY       =  @sEntity,
												BGR_RENTITY      =  @sRentity,	BGR_ORG          =  @sOrg,	BGR_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, BGR_LASTSAVED = getdate()
											where BGR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sOrg,
												@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
												@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldEntity,	@sOldRentity,	@sOldOrg,
												@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_BLC
on R5BLANKETORDCLAUSES
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sBlanketorder		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldBlanketorder	nvarchar(30)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nCount1			int
	declare @nCount2			int
	declare @nCount3			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.BLC_BLANKETORDER, d.BLC_BLANKETORDER, i.BLC_UPDATECOUNT, d.BLC_UPDATECOUNT, i.BLC_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.BLC_SQLIDENTITY = d.BLC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sBlanketorder, @sOldBlanketorder, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @nCount1 = 0
							set @nCount2 = 0
							set @nCount3 = 0


							SELECT @nCount1 = COUNT( * )
							FROM   r5orders o
							WHERE  o.ord_blanketorder = @sOldBlanketorder
							AND    o.ord_rstatus = N'A'



							SELECT @nCount2 = COUNT( * )
							FROM   r5orderlines o
							WHERE  o.orl_blanketorder = @sOldBlanketorder
							AND    o.orl_active = N'+'


							if @nCount1 > 0 or @nCount2 > 0 or @nCount3 > 0 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_BLC', N'TRIG', N'900', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5BLANKETORDCLAUSES set BLC_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, BLC_LASTSAVED = getdate() where BLC_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sBlanketorder, @sOldBlanketorder, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_BUD
on R5BUDGETS
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(17)        
	declare @sYear       		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @dDate       		datetime            
	declare @sCurr       		nvarchar(3)         
	declare @sAuth       		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sKeeper     		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dCalculated 		datetime            
	declare @sStatus     		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRstatus    		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nAmount     		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nOriginal   		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @dApprov     		datetime            
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @dCreated    		datetime            
	declare @dUpdated    		datetime            
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(17)        
	declare @sOldYear       	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @dOldDate       	datetime            
	declare @sOldCurr       	nvarchar(3)         
	declare @sOldAuth       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sOldKeeper     	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dOldCalculated 	datetime            
	declare @sOldStatus     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRstatus    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nOldAmount     	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nOldOriginal   	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @dOldApprov     	datetime            
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime            
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime            

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.BUD_CODE,	i.BUD_YEAR,	i.BUD_DATE,	i.BUD_CURR,	i.BUD_AUTH,
													  	i.BUD_KEEPER,	i.BUD_CALCULATED,	i.BUD_STATUS,	i.BUD_RSTATUS,	i.BUD_AMOUNT,
													  	i.BUD_ORIGINAL,	i.BUD_APPROV,	i.BUD_UPDATECOUNT,	i.BUD_CREATED,	i.BUD_UPDATED,
													 	i.BUD_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.BUD_CODE,	d.BUD_YEAR,	d.BUD_DATE,	d.BUD_CURR,	d.BUD_AUTH,
													  	d.BUD_KEEPER,	d.BUD_CALCULATED,	d.BUD_STATUS,	d.BUD_RSTATUS,	d.BUD_AMOUNT,
													  	d.BUD_ORIGINAL,	d.BUD_APPROV,	d.BUD_UPDATECOUNT,	d.BUD_CREATED,	d.BUD_UPDATED
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.BUD_SQLIDENTITY = d.BUD_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sYear,	@dDate,	@sCurr,	@sAuth,
											@sKeeper,	@dCalculated,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@nAmount,
											@nOriginal,	@dApprov,	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
											@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldYear,	@dOldDate,	@sOldCurr,	@sOldAuth,
											@sOldKeeper,	@dOldCalculated,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,	@nOldAmount,
											@nOldOriginal,	@dOldApprov,	@nOldUpdatecount,	@dOldCreated,	@dOldUpdated
										
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX           = NULL

							execute @nReturn = o7prebud N'UPD', @sCode, @sYear, @sRstatus, null, @nAmount, @nOriginal OUTPUT,
											 @sAuth OUTPUT, @dApprov OUTPUT, N'*', @sCheckresult OUTPUT 

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
  
							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREBUD', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							set @dCreated  = getdate()



							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end

				update R5BUDGETS set	BUD_CODE         =  @sCode,	BUD_YEAR         =  @sYear,	BUD_DATE         =  @dDate,
								        BUD_CURR         =  @sCurr,	BUD_AUTH         =  @sAuth,	BUD_KEEPER       =  @sKeeper,
								        BUD_CALCULATED   =  @dCalculated,	BUD_STATUS       =  @sStatus,	BUD_RSTATUS      =  @sRstatus,
								        BUD_AMOUNT       =  @nAmount,	BUD_ORIGINAL     =  @nOriginal,	BUD_APPROV       =  @dApprov,
								        BUD_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount,	BUD_CREATED      =  @dCreated,	BUD_UPDATED      =  @dUpdated
					where BUD_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

				IF @sUser <> N'SYS' 
					begin
						IF @sRstatus = N'40' AND @sOldRstatus <> N'40' 
							begin
								UPDATE r5budgetdetails
								SET    bdt_original = bdt_amount
								WHERE  bdt_budget   = @sCode
								AND    bdt_year     = @sYear
							end
					end

				fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sYear,	@dDate,	@sCurr,	@sAuth,
												@sKeeper,	@dCalculated,	@sStatus,	@sRstatus,	@nAmount,
												@nOriginal,	@dApprov,	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,
												@nSqlidentity,
												@sOldCode,	@sOldYear,	@dOldDate,	@sOldCurr,	@sOldAuth,
												@sOldKeeper,	@dOldCalculated,	@sOldStatus,	@sOldRstatus,	@nOldAmount,
												@nOldOriginal,	@dOldApprov,	@nOldUpdatecount,	@dOldCreated,	@dOldUpdated
														
			end
		close c_ins_del
		deallocate c_ins_del
		end
