	declare @sCal        		nvarchar(2)         
	declare @nPeri       		numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nLoc        		numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nMrc        		numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nObj        		numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nJbtp       		numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nCstp       		numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nLevel      		numeric(1,0)        
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             
	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(17)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldParent     	nvarchar(17)        
	declare @sOldCal        	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @nOldPeri       	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nOldLoc        	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nOldMrc        	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nOldObj        	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nOldJbtp       	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nOldCstp       	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @nOldLevel      	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @sCstc			nvarchar(30) 
	declare @sProj			nvarchar(20) 
	declare @sOldCstc		nvarchar(30) 
	declare @sOldProj		nvarchar(20) 

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.BUS_CODE,	i.BUS_DESC,	i.BUS_PARENT,	i.BUS_CAL,	i.BUS_PERI,
													  	i.BUS_LOC,	i.BUS_MRC,	i.BUS_OBJ,	i.BUS_JBTP,	i.BUS_CSTP,
													 	i.BUS_LEVEL,	i.BUS_ORG,	i.BUS_UPDATECOUNT,	
														i.BUS_CSTC, i.BUS_PROJ, i.BUS_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.BUS_CODE,	d.BUS_DESC,	d.BUS_PARENT,	d.BUS_CAL,	d.BUS_PERI,
													  	d.BUS_LOC,	d.BUS_MRC,	d.BUS_OBJ,	d.BUS_JBTP,	d.BUS_CSTP,
													  	d.BUS_LEVEL,	d.BUS_ORG,	d.BUS_UPDATECOUNT,
														d.BUS_CSTC, d.BUS_PROJ
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.BUS_SQLIDENTITY = d.BUS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sParent,	@sCal,	@nPeri,
											@nLoc,	@nMrc,	@nObj,	@nJbtp,	@nCstp,
											@nLevel,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,	
											@sCstc, @sProj, @nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldParent,	@sOldCal,	@nOldPeri,
											@nOldLoc,	@nOldMrc,	@nOldObj,	@nOldJbtp,	@nOldCstp,
											@nOldLevel,	@sOldOrg,	@nOldUpdatecount,
											@sOldCstc, @sOldProj
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX           = NULL

							IF @sCal   <> @sOldCal
							OR @nPeri  <> @nOldPeri
							OR @nLoc   <> @nOldLoc
							OR @nMrc   <> @nOldMrc
							OR @nObj   <> @nOldObj
							OR @nJbtp  <> @nOldJbtp
							OR @nCstp  <> @nOldCstp
							OR @nLevel <> @nOldLevel
							OR @sOrg   <> @sOldOrg 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = o7prebus N'UPD', @sCode, @sParent, @sCal, @nPeri, @nMrc, @nJbtp, @nCstp, @nObj, @nLoc, @sCstc, @sProj, @nLevel OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
  
							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREBUS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'BSTR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
  
							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						end
					update R5BUDGETSTRUCTURE set	BUS_CODE         =  @sCode,	BUS_DESC         =  @sDesc,	BUS_PARENT       =  @sParent,
								                    BUS_CAL          =  @sCal,	BUS_PERI         =  @nPeri,	BUS_LOC          =  @nLoc,
								                    BUS_MRC          =  @nMrc,	BUS_OBJ          =  @nObj,	BUS_JBTP         =  @nJbtp,
								                    BUS_CSTP         =  @nCstp,	BUS_LEVEL        =  @nLevel,	BUS_ORG          =  @sOrg,
								                    BUS_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, BUS_CSTC	 = @sCstc,  BUS_PROJ		 = @sProj,
								                    BUS_LASTSAVED    = getdate()
						where BUS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sParent,	@sCal,	@nPeri,
											@nLoc,	@nMrc,	@nObj,	@nJbtp,	@nCstp,
											@nLevel,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,	
											@sCstc, @sProj, @nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldParent,	@sOldCal,	@nOldPeri,
											@nOldLoc,	@nOldMrc,	@nOldObj,	@nOldJbtp,	@nOldCstp,
											@nOldLevel,	@sOldOrg,	@nOldUpdatecount,
											@sOldCstc, @sOldProj
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_CAC
on R5CAUSECLASSES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sCause				nvarchar(8)  -- r5causes.cau_gen%TYPE;
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCause			nvarchar(8)  -- r5causes.cau_gen%TYPE;


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.CAC_CLASS, i.CAC_CLASS_ORG, i.CAC_CAUSE, i.CAC_UPDATECOUNT, i.CAC_SQLIDENTITY,  
														d.CAC_CLASS, d.CAC_CLASS_ORG, d.CAC_CAUSE, d.CAC_UPDATECOUNT 
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CAC_SQLIDENTITY = d.CAC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sClass,@sClassOrg,@sCause, @nUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity,
													@sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldCause, @nOldUpdateCount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							/* W41301 - Code and Class not updateable */
							if @sClass		<> @sOldClass	OR
							   @sClassOrg	<> @sOldClassOrg	OR
							   @sCause		<> @sOldCause
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if @nOldUpdateCount is null
								update R5CAUSECLASSES set CAC_UPDATECOUNT =  1 where CAC_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin

									if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
										update R5CAUSECLASSES set CAC_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where CAC_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
									else
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sClass,@sClassOrg,@sCause, @nUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity,
															@sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldCause, @nOldUpdateCount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_CAL
on R5CALENDARS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(20)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sPeriod			numeric(2)
	declare @sOldPeriod			numeric(2)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.CAL_CODE, i.CAL_DESC, i.CAL_CLASS, i.CAL_CLASS_ORG , i.CAL_PERIODS, i.CAL_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.CAL_CODE, d.CAL_DESC, d.CAL_CLASS, d.CAL_CLASS_ORG , d.CAL_PERIODS, d.CAL_UPDATECOUNT, i.CAL_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CAL_SQLIDENTITY = d.CAL_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @sPeriod, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldPeriod, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							IF @sPeriod <> @sOldPeriod 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end


								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CAL', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CAL', N'TRIG', 2
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end


							--PREUPD2_CAL portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5CALENDARS set CAL_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, CAL_LASTSAVED = getdate() where CAL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CAL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (coalesce(@sOldClass,N'*')  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg) <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'CAL'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @sPeriod, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldPeriod, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_CAT
on R5CATALOGUE
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nGross			numeric(24,6)     
	declare @nPurprice		numeric(24,6)
	declare @dExppurpr		datetime  
	declare @sPart			nvarchar(30)      
	declare @sPart_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @dDate			datetime
	declare @sInsertoldreference	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sRef			nvarchar(50)
	declare @sOldref		nvarchar(50)      
	declare @sSupplier		nvarchar(30)  
	declare @sSupplier_org	nvarchar(15)
	declare @dExpquot		datetime   
	declare @nQuotprice		numeric(24,6) 
	declare @sQuotuom		nvarchar(30)  
	declare @sQuotation		nvarchar(30)  
	declare @sOldSupplier	nvarchar(30)  
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select I.CAT_GROSS, I.CAT_PURPRICE, I.CAT_EXPPURPR, I.CAT_PART, I.CAT_PART_ORG, I.CAT_DATE, I.CAT_INSERTOLDREFERENCE, I.CAT_REF, D.CAT_REF,    
								I.CAT_SUPPLIER, I.CAT_SUPPLIER_ORG, I.CAT_EXPQUOT, I.CAT_QUOTPRICE, I.CAT_QUOTUOM, I.CAT_QUOTATION, I.CAT_UPDATECOUNT, D.CAT_SUPPLIER, D.CAT_UPDATECOUNT, I.CAT_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CAT_SQLIDENTITY = d.CAT_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nGross, @nPurprice, @dExppurpr, @sPart, @sPart_org, @dDate, @sInsertoldreference, @sRef, @sOldref,      
									@sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @dExpquot, @nQuotprice, @sQuotuom, @sQuotation, @nUpdatecount, @sOldSupplier, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sSupplier <> @sOldSupplier 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End


							execute @nReturn = O7PRECAT N'UPD',@nGross, @nPurprice OUTPUT, @dExppurpr, @sPart, @sPart_org, @dDate OUTPUT,      
																@sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @dExpquot OUTPUT, @nQuotprice OUTPUT, @sQuotuom OUTPUT, 
																@sQuotation, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRECAT', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update R5CATALOGUE set cat_Purprice = @nPurprice,
							cat_Date = @dDate,
							cat_Expquot = @dExpquot,
							cat_Quotprice = @nQuotprice,
							cat_Quotuom = @sQuotuom,
							cat_Insertoldreference = null
							where CAT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							if @sInsertoldreference = N'+' and @sOldref is not null and @sOldref <> isnull( @sRef, N'x1y2z' )
								begin
									if not exists ( select 'x' from r5catalogreferences where crf_part = @sPart and crf_part_org = @sPart_org 
											and  crf_supplier = @sSupplier and crf_supplier_org = @sSupplier_org and crf_reference = @sOldref )
										begin
											insert into r5catalogreferences( crf_part, crf_part_org, crf_supplier, crf_supplier_org, crf_reference )
											values( @sPart, @sPart_org, @sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @sOldref )
										end
								end

							--PREUPD2_CAT portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5CATALOGUE set CAT_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, CAT_LASTSAVED = getdate() where CAT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nGross, @nPurprice, @dExppurpr, @sPart, @sPart_org, @dDate, @sInsertoldreference, @sRef, @sOldref,      
											@sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @dExpquot, @nQuotprice, @sQuotuom, @sQuotation, @nUpdatecount, @sOldSupplier, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_CBC
ON r5creditbalancechanges
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT cbc_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5creditbalancechanges
          SET    cbc_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  cbc_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

create trigger PREUPD_CCL
on R5CONCLAUSES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClass_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sParent			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sLine				nvarchar(8)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @sOldClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClass_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
declare @nError		int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.CCL_CODE, i.CCL_ORG,  i.CCL_DESC, i.CCL_CLASS, i.CCL_CLASS_ORG, i.CCL_PARENT, i.CCL_LINE, i.CCL_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.CCL_CODE, d.CCL_CLASS, d.CCL_CLASS_ORG, d.CCL_UPDATECOUNT, i.CCL_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CCL_SQLIDENTITY = d.CCL_SQLIDENTITY

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClass_org, @sParent, @sLine, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								
							execute @nReturn = O7PRECCL N'UPD', @sClass, @sClass_org, @sParent, @sLine,  @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PRECCL', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							--PREUPD2_CCL portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5CONCLAUSES set CCL_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, CCL_LASTSAVED = getdate()  where CCL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CLAU', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClass_org, @sParent, @sLine, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end

create trigger PREUPD_CFS
on R5CONFIGSETTINGS
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sGroup      		nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sUser       		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sComptype   		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @dCreated    		datetime            
	declare @dUpdated    		datetime            
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldGroup      	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sOldUser       	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @sOldComptype   	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime            
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime            
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)      

    declare @sMobReset          nvarchar(8)	
	declare @sUserid		nvarchar(255)
	declare @nReturn			int		

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.CFS_CODE,	i.CFS_GROUP,	i.CFS_USER,	i.CFS_COMPTYPE,	
													 	i.CFS_CREATED,	i.CFS_UPDATED,	i.CFS_UPDATECOUNT,	i.CFS_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.CFS_CODE,	d.CFS_GROUP,	d.CFS_USER,	d.CFS_COMPTYPE,	
													  	d.CFS_CREATED,	d.CFS_UPDATED,	d.CFS_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.CFS_SQLIDENTITY = d.CFS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sGroup,	@sUser,	@sComptype,	
												   	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldGroup,	@sOldUser,	@sOldComptype,	
													@dOldCreated,	@dOldUpdated,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @dUpdated = GetDate()
							update R5CONFIGSETTINGS set cfs_updated = @dUpdated where CFS_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlidentity

							IF @sCode =N'SYNCON_IPAD' AND @sGroup <> N'*' AND @sUser = N'*'
							BEGIN
							    EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_USER @sUserid OUTPUT
							    if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								BEGIN
									SELECT @sUserid = ''
								END
								
								SET @sMobReset = N'NO'
								SELECT @sMobReset = N'YES' FROM dual where 
								   (  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code=N'MOBRESET' AND ins_desc=N'YES') 
								      OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5install WHERE ins_code=N'MOBRESET'))
									AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM r5users WHERE usr_code = @sUserid AND usr_mobileadm=N'+')

								IF @sMobReset=N'YES'
									DELETE FROM r5configsettings
									WHERE cfs_code= @sCode
									AND cfs_group = @sGroup AND cfs_user <> N'*'
							END
							
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5CONFIGSETTINGS set CFS_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where CFS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sGroup,	@sUser,	@sComptype,	
														   	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
															@sOldCode,	@sOldGroup,	@sOldUser,	@sOldComptype,	
															@dOldCreated,	@dOldUpdated,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @sOldRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldRentitycode	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldEntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nUpdateCount		int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sNotused			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.CLS_CODE, i.CLS_ORG, i.CLS_RENTITY, i.CLS_RENTITYCODE, i.CLS_DESC, i.CLS_ENTITY, i.CLS_NOTUSED,
														d.CLS_CODE, d.CLS_ORG, d.CLS_RENTITY, d.CLS_RENTITYCODE, d.CLS_DESC, d.CLS_ENTITY, i.CLS_SQLIDENTITY, i.CLS_UPDATECOUNT, d.CLS_UPDATECOUNT
												from	inserted i, deleted d
												where	i.CLS_SQLIDENTITY = d.CLS_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sRentity, @sRentitycode, @sDesc, @sEntity, @sNotused, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldRentity, @sOldRentitycode, @sOldDesc, @sOldEntity, @nSqlIdentity, @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
							if @sEntity <> @sOldEntity	OR
							  @sRentity <> @sOldRentity	OR
							  @sCode	<> @sOldCode	OR
							  @sOrg		<> @sOldOrg
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5CLASSES set CLS_UPDATECOUNT = isnull(CLS_UPDATECOUNT, -1) + 1,
														CLS_UPDATED = GetDate()
								  where CLS_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CLAS', @sRentitycode, @sRentity, @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							
							-- add Databridge event to r5xmltranstatus table
							if @sRentity = N'EVNT'
							begin
								SELECT @sFlag = isnull(INS_DESC, N'N') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'
								if upper(@sFlag) = N'A'
								begin
									EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_inserted
										deallocate c_inserted
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

									INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
									(XTS_TRANTYPE,XTS_TABLE,XTS_KEYFLD1,XTS_KEYFLD2,XTS_KEYFLD3,XTS_ORG,XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
									VALUES
									(N'CODEDEF',N'WOCLASS',@sCode,@sDesc,@sNotused,@sOrg,@sTempMsgid)
								end
							end							
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sRentity, @sRentitycode, @sDesc, @sEntity, @sNotused, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldRentity, @sOldRentitycode, @sOldDesc, @sOldEntity, @nSqlIdentity, @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_CMD
on R5COMMODITIES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.CMD_CODE, i.CMD_ORG, i.CMD_DESC, i.CMD_CLASS, i.CMD_CLASS_ORG , i.CMD_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.CMD_CODE, d.CMD_ORG, d.CMD_DESC, d.CMD_CLASS, d.CMD_CLASS_ORG , d.CMD_UPDATECOUNT, i.CMD_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CMD_SQLIDENTITY = d.CMD_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							/* M09211 - Commodity is not updateable    */
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CMD', N'TRIG', 4
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								/* M09221 - Class must exist ( r5classes, rEntity = 'COMM' ) */
								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'COMM', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CMD', N'TRIG', 3
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										else
											set @sX= null
									end

							--PREUPD2_CMD portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5COMMODITIES set CMD_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, CMD_LASTSAVED = getdate()  where CMD_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSUPD_CMD portion
							/* M09250 - update descriptions */
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'COMM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							/* M09213 - If Class is updated remove old class's custom prop. values   */
							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( coalesce(@sOldClass,N'*') <> coalesce(@sClass, N'*') OR coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg) <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'COMM'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END



		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_CND
on R5CONDITIONS
instead of update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass      		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sClass_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0) 

    declare @sNotused           nvarchar(1)

	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE	      

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.CND_CODE,	i.CND_DESC,	i.CND_CLASS,	i.CND_CLASS_ORG,	i.CND_UPDATECOUNT,
													 	i.CND_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.CND_CODE,	d.CND_DESC,	d.CND_CLASS,	d.CND_CLASS_ORG,	d.CND_UPDATECOUNT,
													    i.CND_NOTUSED
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.CND_SQLIDENTITY = d.CND_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
										   	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldUpdatecount,
										    @sNotused
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							If @sClass is not null AND @sClass<> coalesce(@sOldClass, N'*') OR @sClass_org <> coalesce (@sOldClass_org, @sDeforg)
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'COND', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CND', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

								end
			
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'COND', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND  (@sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass,N'*') 
							OR @sClass_org <> coalesce(@sOldClass_org,@sDeforg))
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'COND'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode


						end
					update R5CONDITIONS set	CND_CODE         =  @sCode,	CND_DESC         =  @sDesc,	CND_CLASS        =  @sClass,
						                   	CND_CLASS_ORG    =  @sClass_org,	CND_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount,
                                            CND_NOTUSED = @sNotused, CND_LASTSAVED = getdate() 
						where CND_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,
												   	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldUpdatecount,
                                                    @sNotused
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_CNV
on R5CONVUOM
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as

	declare @sUomTo				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldSupplier		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldSupplier_org	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldUomFrom		nvarchar(30)	
	declare @sOldUomTo			nvarchar(30)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin

				begin

				end

		end

create trigger PREUPD_CON
on R5CONTRACTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCODE          nvarchar (30)  
	declare @sDESC          nvarchar (80)
	declare @sCLASS         nvarchar (8) 
	declare @sSUPPLIER      nvarchar (30)
	declare @sLANG          nvarchar (2)
	declare @sCURR          nvarchar (3)
	declare @sCOPY          nvarchar (30) 
	declare @sSTORE         nvarchar (15)
	declare @sSTATUS        nvarchar (4)
	declare @sRSTATUS       nvarchar (4)
	declare @sOWN           nvarchar (1)
	declare @sREF           nvarchar (50) 
	declare @dCREATE        datetime
	declare @dSTART         datetime
	declare @dEND           datetime
	declare @dRENEW         datetime
	declare @sPRINTED       nvarchar (1)
	declare @sOWNCONTACT    nvarchar (15)
	declare @sCONTACT       nvarchar (45) 
	declare @sORG           nvarchar (15)
	declare @sCLASS_ORG     nvarchar (15) 
	declare @sSUPPLIER_ORG  nvarchar (15)
	declare @sOldCODE          nvarchar (30)  
	declare @sOldDESC          nvarchar (80)
	declare @sOldCLASS         nvarchar (8) 
	declare @sOldSUPPLIER      nvarchar (30)
	declare @sOldLANG          nvarchar (2)
	declare @sOldCURR          nvarchar (3)
	declare @sOldCOPY          nvarchar (30) 
	declare @sOldSTORE         nvarchar (15)
	declare @sOldSTATUS        nvarchar (4)
	declare @sOldRSTATUS       nvarchar (4)
	declare @sOldOWN           nvarchar (1)
	declare @sOldREF           nvarchar (50) 
	declare @dOldCREATE        datetime
	declare @dOldSTART         datetime
	declare @dOldEND           datetime
	declare @dOldRENEW         datetime
	declare @sOldPRINTED       nvarchar (1)
	declare @sOldOWNCONTACT    nvarchar (15)
	declare @sOldCONTACT       nvarchar (45) 
	declare @sOldORG           nvarchar (15)
	declare @sOldCLASS_ORG     nvarchar (15) 
	declare @sOldSUPPLIER_ORG  nvarchar (15)



	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.CON_CODE, i.CON_DESC, i.CON_CLASS, i.CON_SUPPLIER, i.CON_LANG, i.CON_CURR, i.CON_COPY, i.CON_STORE, i.CON_STATUS, i.CON_RSTATUS, i.CON_OWN, i.CON_REF, 
														i.CON_CREATE, i.CON_START, i.CON_END, i.CON_RENEW, i.CON_PRINTED, i.CON_OWNCONTACT, i.CON_CONTACT, i.CON_ORG, i.CON_CLASS_ORG, i.CON_SUPPLIER_ORG, i.CON_UPDATECOUNT,
														d.CON_CODE, d.CON_DESC, d.CON_CLASS, d.CON_SUPPLIER, d.CON_LANG, d.CON_CURR, d.CON_COPY, d.CON_STORE, d.CON_STATUS, d.CON_RSTATUS, d.CON_OWN, d.CON_REF, 
														d.CON_CREATE, d.CON_START, d.CON_END, d.CON_RENEW, d.CON_PRINTED, d.CON_OWNCONTACT, d.CON_CONTACT, d.CON_ORG, d.CON_CLASS_ORG, d.CON_SUPPLIER_ORG, d.CON_UPDATECOUNT,
														i.CON_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CON_SQLIDENTITY = d.CON_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCODE, @sDESC, @sCLASS, @sSUPPLIER, @sLANG, @sCURR, @sCOPY, @sSTORE, @sSTATUS, @sRSTATUS, 
													@sOWN, @sREF, @dCREATE, @dSTART, @dEND, @dRENEW, @sPRINTED, @sOWNCONTACT, @sCONTACT, @sORG, 
													@sCLASS_ORG, @sSUPPLIER_ORG, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCODE, @sOldDESC, @sOldCLASS, @sOldSUPPLIER, 
													@sOldLANG, @sOldCURR, @sOldCOPY, @sOldSTORE, @sOldSTATUS, @sOldRSTATUS, @sOldOWN, @sOldREF, 
													@dOldCREATE, @dOldSTART, @dOldEND, @dOldRENEW, @sOldPRINTED, @sOldOWNCONTACT, @sOldCONTACT, 
													@sOldORG, @sOldCLASS_ORG, @sOldSUPPLIER_ORG ,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF  @sOldRSTATUS   <> N'U' 
								begin
										IF @sCODE         <> @sOldCODE OR
										@sSUPPLIER     <> @sOldSUPPLIER OR
										@sSUPPLIER_ORG <> @sOldSUPPLIER_ORG OR
										@sCURR        <> @sOldCURR OR
										@dCREATE       <> @dOldCREATE OR
										@sCOPY        <> @sOldCOPY OR
										@sDESC         <> @sOldDESC OR
										@sCLASS        <> @sOldCLASS OR
										@sCLASS_ORG    <> @sOldCLASS_ORG OR
										@sLANG         <> @sOldLANG OR
										@sCURR         <> @sOldCURR OR
										@sREF          <> @sOldREF OR
										@sSTORE       <> @sOldSTORE OR
										@dSTART        <> @dOldSTART OR
										@dEND          <> @dOldEND OR
										@dRENEW       <> @dOldRENEW OR
										coalesce(@sCONTACT, N'x')      <> coalesce(@sOldCONTACT, N'x') OR
										coalesce(@sOWN, N'x')          <> coalesce(@sOldOWN, N'x') OR
										@sORG          <> @sOldORG 
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_CON', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
								end

							IF @sCODE         <> @sOldCODE OR
								@sSUPPLIER     <> @sOldSUPPLIER OR
								@sSUPPLIER_ORG <> @sOldSUPPLIER_ORG OR
								@sCURR        <> @sOldCURR OR
								@dCREATE       <> @dOldCREATE OR
								@sCOPY        <> @sOldCOPY OR
								@sLANG         <> @sOldLANG 

								Begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5CONTRACTS set CON_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, CON_LASTSAVED = getdate()  where CON_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CONT', @sX, N'*', @sCODE, @sORG, @sDESC, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							IF Coalesce( @sOldCLASS, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldCLASS <> coalesce(@sCLASS, N'*') OR @sOldCLASS_ORG <> Coalesce(@sCLASS_ORG,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'CONT'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldCLASS
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldCLASS_ORG
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCODE
								END

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCODE, @sDESC, @sCLASS, @sSUPPLIER, @sLANG, @sCURR, @sCOPY, @sSTORE, @sSTATUS, @sRSTATUS, 
															@sOWN, @sREF, @dCREATE, @dSTART, @dEND, @dRENEW, @sPRINTED, @sOWNCONTACT, @sCONTACT, @sORG, 
															@sCLASS_ORG, @sSUPPLIER_ORG, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCODE, @sOldDESC, @sOldCLASS, @sOldSUPPLIER, 
															@sOldLANG, @sOldCURR, @sOldCOPY, @sOldSTORE, @sOldSTATUS, @sOldRSTATUS, @sOldOWN, @sOldREF, 
															@dOldCREATE, @dOldSTART, @dOldEND, @dOldRENEW, @sOldPRINTED, @sOldOWNCONTACT, @sOldCONTACT, 
															@sOldORG, @sOldCLASS_ORG, @sOldSUPPLIER_ORG ,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_CPH
ON r5changeparthistory
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT cph_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5changeparthistory
          SET    cph_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  cph_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

create trigger PREUPD_CPR
on R5CAPITALPLANNINGREQUESTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sDeforg		nvarchar(400)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldCode		nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nSQLIdentity	int
	declare @sInobjupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.CPR_CODE, i.CPR_ORG, i.CPR_CLASS, i.CPR_CLASS_ORG, i.CPR_DESC,
														d.CPR_CODE, d.CPR_ORG, d.CPR_CLASS, d.CPR_CLASS_ORG, i.CPR_SQLIDENTITY
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.CPR_SQLIDENTITY = d.CPR_SQLIDENTITY


			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nSQLIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sX = NULL

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode or @sOrg <> @sOldOrg
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sClass is not null and
							 ( @sClass <> coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) OR
							   @sClassOrg <> coalesce( @sOldClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CPRQ', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CPR', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CPRQ', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*') <> N'*' AND
							 ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) OR
							   @sOldClassOrg <> coalesce( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'CPRQ'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode + '#' + @sOldOrg

							if @@ERROR <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nSQLIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_CRD
on R5CREDITCARDS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)

	declare @nReturn			int

	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.CRD_CODE, i.CRD_DESC, i.CRD_CLASS, i.CRD_CLASS_ORG , i.CRD_ORG, i.CRD_TYPE, i.CRD_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.CRD_CODE, d.CRD_DESC, d.CRD_CLASS, d.CRD_CLASS_ORG , d.CRD_ORG, d.CRD_UPDATECOUNT, i.CRD_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CRD_SQLIDENTITY = d.CRD_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @sOrg, @sType, @nUpdatecount, 
													@nOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							IF @nCode <> @nOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CARD', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CRD', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

								execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'CCTP', @sType, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								if @nCountit = 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CRD', N'TRIG', 2
										rollback transaction
										return
									end



							--PREUPD2_CRD portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5CREDITCARDS set CRD_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, CRD_LASTSAVED = getdate() where CRD_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							set @sCode = cast(@nCode as nvarchar(38))
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CARD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return

									deallocate c_ins_del

								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (@sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'CARD'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @nOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @sOrg, @sType, @nUpdatecount, 
															@nOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCURR, @dEND, @dSTART, @sORGCURR,   @nUpdatecount, @sOldCURR, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del

									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CREW', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CRW', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CREW', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end								

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClassOrg,
											@nUpdatecount, @sOldCode, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass,
											@sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_CUR
on R5CURRENCIES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(3)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(3)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.CUR_CODE, i.CUR_DESC, i.CUR_CLASS, i.CUR_CLASS_ORG , i.CUR_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.CUR_CODE, d.CUR_DESC, d.CUR_CLASS, d.CUR_CLASS_ORG , d.CUR_UPDATECOUNT, i.CUR_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.CUR_SQLIDENTITY = d.CUR_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'1'
			set @nCountit = 0
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							-- preupd_cur
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end



								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'CURR', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_CUR', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							--PREUPD2_CUR portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5CURRENCIES set CUR_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where CUR_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSUPD_CUR portion
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'CURR', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (@sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'CURR'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END

		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_DAE
on R5DOCENTITIES
instead of update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sDocument   		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sEntity     		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRentity    		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sType       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sRtype      		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(50)        
	declare @sCopytowo   		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sCreateCopytowo	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sPrintonwo  		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sCopytopo   		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sPrintonpo  		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldDocument   	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldEntity     	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRentity    	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldType       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldRtype      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(50)        
	declare @sOldCopytowo   	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldCreateCopytowo	nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldPrintonwo  	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldCopytopo   	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldPrintonpo  	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)
    
	declare @nReturn			integer
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)            
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.DAE_DOCUMENT,	i.DAE_ENTITY,	i.DAE_RENTITY,	i.DAE_TYPE,	i.DAE_RTYPE,
													  	i.DAE_CODE,	i.DAE_COPYTOWO,	i.DAE_PRINTONWO,	i.DAE_COPYTOPO,	i.DAE_PRINTONPO,
													 	i.DAE_UPDATECOUNT,	i.DAE_SQLIDENTITY,i.DAE_CREATECOPYTOWO,
													  	d.DAE_DOCUMENT,	d.DAE_ENTITY,	d.DAE_RENTITY,	d.DAE_TYPE,	d.DAE_RTYPE,
													  	d.DAE_CODE,	d.DAE_COPYTOWO,	d.DAE_PRINTONWO,	d.DAE_COPYTOPO,	d.DAE_PRINTONPO,
													  	d.DAE_UPDATECOUNT, d.DAE_CREATECOPYTOWO
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.DAE_SQLIDENTITY = d.DAE_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sDocument,	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sType,	@sRtype,
										   	@sCode,	@sCopytowo,	@sPrintonwo,	@sCopytopo,	@sPrintonpo,
										   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,@sCreateCopytowo,
											@sOldDocument,	@sOldEntity,	@sOldRentity,	@sOldType,	@sOldRtype,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldCopytowo,	@sOldPrintonwo,	@sOldCopytopo,	@sOldPrintonpo,
											@nOldUpdatecount,@sOldCreateCopytowo
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
						begin
                            IF ( @sRentity = N'REQL' ) 
                                begin
                                    set @sRentity = N'REQ'
                                    execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7UCODE @sEntity OUTPUT, N'REQ', N'ENTP', @sChk OUTPUT
							        if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								        begin
									        close c_ins_del
									        deallocate c_ins_del
									        rollback transaction
									        return
								        end
                                end

							-- Check if DAE_DOCUMENT has been changed
							IF @sDocument <> @sOldDocument
								BEGIN
									CLOSE c_ins_del
									DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
									EXECUTE O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
									RETURN									
								END
								
								-- Increment the UpdateCount field

							if coalesce( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = coalesce( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								 set @nUpdatecount = coalesce( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5DOCENTITIES set	DAE_DOCUMENT     =  @sDocument,	DAE_ENTITY       	=  @sEntity,		DAE_RENTITY      =  @sRentity,
						                    	DAE_TYPE         =  @sType,	DAE_RTYPE       	=  @sRtype,		DAE_CODE         =  @sCode,
						                    	DAE_COPYTOWO     =  @sCopytowo,	DAE_PRINTONWO    	=  @sPrintonwo,		DAE_COPYTOPO     =  @sCopytopo,
						                    	DAE_PRINTONPO    =  @sPrintonpo,DAE_CREATECOPYTOWO     	=  @sCreateCopytowo,	DAE_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, 
						                    	DAE_LASTSAVED    =  getdate()
						where DAE_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sDocument,	@sEntity,	@sRentity,	@sType,	@sRtype,
												   	@sCode,	@sCopytowo,	@sPrintonwo,	@sCopytopo,	@sPrintonpo,
												   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,@sCreateCopytowo,
													@sOldDocument,	@sOldEntity,	@sOldRentity,	@sOldType,	@sOldRtype,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldCopytowo,	@sOldPrintonwo,	@sOldCopytopo,	@sOldPrintonpo,
													@nOldUpdatecount,@sOldCreateCopytowo
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_DBE
on R5DATABRIDGEERRORS
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @nTransid     		integer       
	declare @nXtsseqnum   		integer       
	declare @nParentseqnum		integer       
	declare @dCreate      		datetime            
	declare @sErrormessage		varchar(4000)      
	declare @nGltransid   		integer       
	declare @nRunid       		integer       
	declare @sGltable     		nvarchar(120)       
	declare @sGlprocess   		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sTblrowid    		nvarchar(250)       
	declare @nGlentryid   		integer       
	declare @nUpdatecount 		numeric(38)        
	declare @nSqlidentity 		integer             

	declare @nOldUpdatecount 	numeric(38)        

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.DBE_TRANSID,	i.DBE_XTSSEQNUM,	i.DBE_PARENTSEQNUM,	i.DBE_CREATE,	i.DBE_ERRORMESSAGE,
													  	i.DBE_GLTRANSID,	i.DBE_RUNID,	i.DBE_GLTABLE,	i.DBE_GLPROCESS,	i.DBE_TBLROWID,
													 	i.DBE_GLENTRYID,	i.DBE_UPDATECOUNT,	i.DBE_SQLIDENTITY, d.DBE_UPDATECOUNT

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del

										   	@nGltransid,	@nRunid,	@sGltable,	@sGlprocess,	@sTblrowid,
										   	@nGlentryid,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity, @nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin

						                         	DBE_RUNID         =  @nRunid,	DBE_GLTABLE       =  @sGltable,	DBE_GLPROCESS     =  @sGlprocess,
						                         	DBE_TBLROWID      =  @sTblrowid,	DBE_GLENTRYID     =  @nGlentryid,	DBE_UPDATECOUNT   =  @nUpdatecount, 
						                         	DBE_LASTSAVED     = getdate()
						where DBE_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nTransid,	@nXtsseqnum,	@nParentseqnum,	@dCreate,	@sErrormessage,
												   	@nGltransid,	@nRunid,	@sGltable,	@sGlprocess,	@sTblrowid,
												   	@nGlentryid,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity, @nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0

							if @sRstatus <> N'U'

									  @sOrder_org <> @sOldOrder_org or @dRecvdate <> @dOldRecvdate or
									  @sDockid <> @sOldDockid or @sLocation <> @sOldLocation or
									  @sShipvia <> @sOldShipvia or @sPackslip <> @sOldPackslip or
									  @sFreight <> @sOldFreight or @sReference <> @sOldReference or
									  @sMrc <> @sOldMrc or

											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_DCK', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return

								end

							execute @nReturn = O7PREDCK N'UPD', @sOrg, @sOldRstatus, @sSupplier, @sSupplier_org, @sOrder, @sOrder_org,

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0

						                     	DCK_REFERENCE     =  @sReference,	DCK_MRC           =  @sMrc,	DCK_RECEIVER      =  @sReceiver,
						                     	DCK_CREATED       =  @dCreated,	DCK_USER          =  @sUser,	DCK_UPDATED       =  @dUpdated,
						                     	DCK_UPDUSER       =  @sUpduser,	DCK_CLASS         =  @sClass,	DCK_CLASS_ORG     =  @sClass_org,
						                     	DCK_UPDATECOUNT   =  @nUpdatecount, DCK_RETRIEVEALL = @sRetrieveall

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_DCS
ON r5debcodestruct
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT dcs_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5debcodestruct
          SET    dcs_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  dcs_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

create trigger PREUPD_DDF
on R5DDFIELD
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nFieldId			numeric(14,0)
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sTablename         nvarchar(50)
	declare @sSourcename 	    varchar(1000)
	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.DDF_UPDATECOUNT, i.DDF_TABLENAME, d.DDF_UPDATECOUNT, i.DDF_FIELDID, i.DDF_SQLIDENTITY, i.DDF_SOURCENAME
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.DDF_SQLIDENTITY = d.DDF_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount,@sTablename, @nOldUpdateCount, @nFieldId, @nSqlIdentity, @sSourcename
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @nUpdatecount = @nOldUpdateCount
								begin
									update R5DDFIELD set DDF_UPDATECOUNT = DDF_UPDATECOUNT + 1, DDF_LASTSAVED = getdate() 
								  	  where DDF_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
								  	  IF @sTablename IS NULL or @sTablename = ''
									  begin
								  		set @sTablename=dbo.o7fldtbl(@sSourcename)
										update R5DDFIELD set DDF_TABLENAME=@sTablename
									  	where DDF_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
									  end
								end
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									--this is an educated guess that something else is catching "db_error" exceptions
									--  the same way that the other objects we have converted have done which is this statement below
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @sTablename, @nOldUpdateCount, @nFieldId, @nSqlIdentity,@sSourcename
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

NOT FOR REPLICATION

	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nDdspyid			numeric(14,0)
	declare	@nSQLIdentity		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.DDS_UPDATECOUNT, d.DDS_UPDATECOUNT, i.DDS_DDSPYID, i.DDS_SQLIDENTITY
										   from inserted i, deleted d

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

				begin

								update R5DDDATASPY set DDS_UPDATECOUNT = 1, DDS_UPDATED=getdate()

							else

									else

								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nDdspyid, @nSQLIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_DES
on R5DESCRIPTIONS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(32)
	declare @sOldEntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldREntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldRType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(100)
	declare @sOldLang			nvarchar(2)
	declare @sNewEntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sNewREntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sNewType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sNewRType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sNewCode			nvarchar(100)
	declare @sNewLang			nvarchar(2)
	declare @nNewUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount		int
	declare @sNewOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nSQLIdentity			bigint
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sInobjectupdate		nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT

			declare c_ins_del cursor local for	select	i.des_entity,		d.des_entity,
														i.des_rentity,		d.des_rentity,
														i.des_type,			d.des_type,
														i.des_rtype,		d.des_rtype,
														i.des_code,			d.des_code,
														i.des_lang,			d.des_lang,
														i.des_updatecount,	d.des_updatecount,
														i.des_org,			d.des_org,
														i.des_sqlidentity
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.des_sqlidentity	= d.des_sqlidentity

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del

					fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sNewEntity,		@sOldEntity,
													@sNewREntity,		@sOldREntity,
													@sNewType,			@sOldType,
													@sNewRType,			@sOldRType,
													@sNewCode,			@sOldCode,
													@sNewLang,			@sOldLang,
													@nNewUpdatecount,	@nOldUpdatecount,
													@sNewOrg,			@sOldOrg,
													@nSQLIdentity

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if	(@sNewEntity	<> @sOldEntity)		OR
								(@sNewREntity	<> @sOldREntity)	OR
								(@sNewType		<> @sOldType)		OR
								(@sNewRType		<> @sOldRType)		OR
								(@sNewCode		<> @sOldCode)		OR
								(@sNewLang		<> @sOldLang)
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
								end

							if coalesce(@nNewUpdatecount, -1) = coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1)
									update r5descriptions set des_updatecount = coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1) + 1, DES_LASTSAVED = getdate()
									 where	des_sqlidentity	= @nSQLIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1'
									rollback transaction
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sNewEntity,		@sOldEntity,
															@sNewREntity,		@sOldREntity,
															@sNewType,			@sOldType,
															@sNewRType,			@sOldRType,
															@sNewCode,			@sOldCode,
															@sNewLang,			@sOldLang,
															@nNewUpdatecount,	@nOldUpdatecount,
															@sNewOrg,			@sOldOrg,
															@nSQLIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_DEV
on R5DEVICES
instead of update
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sCatflag    		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sRtype      		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sType       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sCategory   		nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sDriver     		nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sMode       		nvarchar(10)        
	declare @sSpecial    		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOrientation		nvarchar(10)        
	declare @sDestination		nvarchar(100)       
	declare @sOrg        		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             
	declare @dUpdated    		datetime            

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldCatflag    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldRtype      	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldType       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldCategory   	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sOldDriver     	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldMode       	nvarchar(10)        
	declare @sOldSpecial    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldOrientation	nvarchar(10)        
	declare @sOldDestination	nvarchar(100)       
	declare @sOldOrg        	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime   
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(4)

    declare @sNotused          nvarchar(1)
    declare @sLastlogindate    datetime
    declare @sOldLastlogindate datetime
	         

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.DEV_CODE,	i.DEV_DESC,	i.DEV_CATFLAG,	i.DEV_RTYPE,	i.DEV_TYPE,
													  	i.DEV_CATEGORY,	i.DEV_DRIVER,	i.DEV_MODE,	i.DEV_SPECIAL,	i.DEV_ORIENTATION,
													  	i.DEV_DESTINATION,	i.DEV_ORG,	i.DEV_UPDATECOUNT,	i.DEV_SQLIDENTITY,	i.DEV_UPDATED,i.DEV_LASTLOGINDATE
													 ,
													  	d.DEV_CODE,	d.DEV_DESC,	d.DEV_CATFLAG,	d.DEV_RTYPE,	d.DEV_TYPE,
													  	d.DEV_CATEGORY,	d.DEV_DRIVER,	d.DEV_MODE,	d.DEV_SPECIAL,	d.DEV_ORIENTATION,
													  	d.DEV_DESTINATION,	d.DEV_ORG,	d.DEV_UPDATECOUNT,	d.DEV_UPDATED,d.DEV_LASTLOGINDATE,
                                                        i.DEV_NOTUSED
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.DEV_SQLIDENTITY = d.DEV_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sCatflag,	@sRtype,	@sType,
										   	@sCategory,	@sDriver,	@sMode,	@sSpecial,	@sOrientation,
										   	@sDestination,	@sOrg,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,	@dUpdated,@sLastlogindate
										   ,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldCatflag,	@sOldRtype,	@sOldType,
											@sOldCategory,	@sOldDriver,	@sOldMode,	@sOldSpecial,	@sOldOrientation,
											@sOldDestination,	@sOldOrg,	@nOldUpdatecount,	@dOldUpdated,@sOldLastlogindate,
                                            @sNotused
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sX = null
							execute @nReturn = O7PREDEV N'INS', @sCode,  @sDesc,  @sType OUTPUT, @sRtype OUTPUT,  @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREDEV', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update R5DEVICES 
								set DEV_TYPE = @sType, 
									DEV_RTYPE = @sRtype
								where DEV_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'DEVC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin

									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction

								end

							set @dUpdated = getdate()

						end
					update R5DEVICES set	DEV_CODE         =  @sCode,	DEV_DESC         =  @sDesc,	DEV_CATFLAG      =  @sCatflag,
						                	DEV_RTYPE        =  @sRtype,	DEV_TYPE         =  @sType,	DEV_CATEGORY     =  @sCategory,
						                	DEV_DRIVER       =  @sDriver,	DEV_MODE         =  @sMode,	DEV_SPECIAL      =  @sSpecial,
						                	DEV_ORIENTATION  =  @sOrientation,	DEV_DESTINATION  =  @sDestination,	DEV_ORG          =  @sOrg,
