		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.DIA_CODE, i.DIA_DESC, i.DIA_CLASS, i.DIA_CLASS_ORG , i.DIA_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.DIA_CODE, d.DIA_DESC, d.DIA_CLASS, d.DIA_CLASS_ORG , d.DIA_UPDATECOUNT, i.DIA_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.DIA_SQLIDENTITY = d.DIA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @nCountit = 0
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end



								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'DIAG', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_DIA', N'TRIG', 2
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5DIAGNOSTICS set DIA_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, DIA_LASTSAVED = getdate() where DIA_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'DIAG', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND (@sClass <> coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*') OR @sClassOrg<> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg ,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'DIAG'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END

		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_DQF
on R5QUERYFIELD
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdateCount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nDDSpyId			int
	declare @nFieldId			int
	declare @sViewType			nvarchar(8)
	declare @nSQLIdentity		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.DQF_UPDATECOUNT, d.DQF_UPDATECOUNT, i.DQF_DDSPYID, i.DQF_FIELDID, i.DQF_VIEWTYPE, i.DQF_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.DQF_SQLIDENTITY	= d.DQF_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nDDSpyId, @nFieldId, @sViewType, @nSQLIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @nOldUpdateCount is null
								update R5QUERYFIELD set DQF_UPDATECOUNT = 1, DQF_UPDATED=getdate() 
								  where DQF_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSQLIdentity
							else
								begin
									if @nUpdateCount = @nOldUpdateCount
										update R5QUERYFIELD set DQF_UPDATECOUNT = DQF_UPDATECOUNT + 1, DQF_UPDATED=getdate() 
										  where DQF_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSQLIdentity
									else
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
										end
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nDDSpyId, @nFieldId, @sViewType, @nSQLIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as

	declare @sCode				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldCode				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.DSZ_CODE, i.DSZ_UPDATECOUNT, d.DSZ_CODE, d.DSZ_UPDATECOUNT, i.DSZ_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.DSZ_SQLIDENTITY = d.DSZ_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

				begin
					open c_ins_del

						while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del

								end

							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCode, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity

			deallocate c_ins_del

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_DUE
ON r5datauploaderrors
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT due_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5datauploaderrors
          SET    due_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  due_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

on r5dataconvexpressions
for update
as
    declare @sChk               nvarchar(4)
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
    declare @sExpression        nvarchar(500)
    declare @sOldExpression     nvarchar(500)
    declare @sLocked            nvarchar(1)
    declare @nSeqid             numeric(38)
    declare @sDestfield         nvarchar(30)
    declare @nReturn            int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON

					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
                            if @sExpression <> @sOldExpression and @sLocked = N'+'
                                begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del

									rollback transaction
									return
                                end

						end
					close c_ins_del
				end

		end

								WHERE  usr_code = @sAppruser

							--PREUPD2 portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )

							else

			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.ENT_ENTITY, i.ENT_RENTITY, i.ENT_TYPENT, i.ENT_STATENT, i.ENT_TABLE, i.ENT_CLASSIF,
														d.ENT_ENTITY, d.ENT_RENTITY, d.ENT_TYPENT, d.ENT_STATENT, d.ENT_TABLE, d.ENT_CLASSIF,
														i.ENT_UPDATECOUNT, d.ENT_UPDATECOUNT
												   from inserted i, deleted d
												  where i.ENT_SQLIDENTITY = d.ENT_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEntity, @sRentity, @sTypent, @sStatent, @sTable, @sClassif, 
													@sOldEntity, @sOldRentity, @sOldTypent, @sOldStatent, @sOldTable, @sOldClassif, 
													@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sEntity <> @sOldEntity	OR
							  @sRentity <> @sOldRentity	OR
							  @sTypent	<> @sOldTypent	OR
							  @sStatent	<> @sOldStatent	OR
							  @sTable	<> @sOldTable	OR
							  @sClassif	<> @sOldClassif
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update r5entities set ent_updated = GetDate() where ent_rentity = @sRentity

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update r5entities set ent_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where ent_rentity = @sRentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEntity, @sRentity, @sTypent, @sStatent, @sTable, @sClassif, 
															@sOldEntity, @sOldRentity, @sOldTypent, @sOldStatent, @sOldTable, @sOldClassif,
															@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount

						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_EPA
on R5ENTITYPARTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sEntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRentity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sType				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sRtype				nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(50)
	declare @sPartlocation		nvarchar(80)
	declare @sPart				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sPartorg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @sOldEntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldRentity		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldRtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(50)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @sOldPartlocation	nvarchar(80)
	declare @nIdent				int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sForgetme              nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INFORGETME @sForgetme OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.EPA_ENTITY, i.EPA_RENTITY, i.EPA_TYPE, i.EPA_RTYPE, i.EPA_CODE,
														d.EPA_ENTITY, d.EPA_RENTITY, d.EPA_TYPE, d.EPA_RTYPE, d.EPA_CODE,
														i.EPA_UPDATECOUNT, d.EPA_UPDATECOUNT, i.EPA_SQLIDENTITY,
														i.EPA_PARTLOCATION, d.EPA_PARTLOCATION, i.EPA_PART, i.EPA_PART_ORG
												   from inserted i, deleted d
												  where i.EPA_SQLIDENTITY = d.EPA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE' and @sForgetme = N'FALSE'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEntity, @sRentity, @sType, @sRtype, @sCode,
													@sOldEntity, @sOldRentity, @sOldType, @sOldRtype, @sOldCode,
													@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nIdent, 
													@sPartlocation, @sOldPartlocation, @sPart, @sPartorg
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sEntity <> @sOldEntity	OR
							  @sRentity <> @sOldRentity	OR
							  @sType	<> @sOldType	OR
							  @sRtype	<> @sOldRtype	OR
							  @sCode	<> @sOldCode	
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sRentity = N'OBJ' and @sPartlocation is not null and @sOldPartlocation is not null and 
								@sPartlocation <> @sOldPartlocation
								begin
									if charindex( N'#', @sCode ) > 0
										-- object.
										update r5partfailures
										set    pfa_partlocation = @sPartlocation
										where  pfa_part = @sPart
										and    pfa_part_org = @sPartorg
										and    pfa_partlocation = @sOldPartlocation
										and exists ( select 'x'
													from   r5events
													where  evt_code = pfa_event
													and    evt_object+N'#'+evt_object_org = @sCode )													
									else
										-- category.
										update r5partfailures
										set    pfa_partlocation = @sPartlocation
										where  pfa_part = @sPart
										and    pfa_part_org = @sPartorg
										and    pfa_partlocation = @sOldPartlocation
										and exists( select 'x'
												from   r5events, r5objects
												where  evt_code = pfa_event
												and    obj_code = evt_object
												and    obj_org = evt_object_org
												and    obj_category = @sCode )
								end


							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update r5entityparts set epa_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, EPA_LASTSAVED = getdate() where epa_sqlidentity = @nIdent
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sEntity, @sRentity, @sType, @sRtype, @sCode,
															@sOldEntity, @sOldRentity, @sOldType, @sOldRtype, @sOldCode,
															@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount, @nIdent, 
															@sPartlocation, @sOldPartlocation, @sPart, @sPartorg

						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_ESE
on R5ENTITYATTRIBUTESETS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sREntity			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sAttributeSetDef	nvarchar(30)
	declare @sValue2			nvarchar(256)
	declare @sOldValue2			nvarchar(256)
	declare @nValue2			bigint
	declare @nOldValue2			bigint

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.ESE_RENTITY, i.ESE_ATTRIBUTESETDEF, ltrim(rtrim(i.ESE_VALUE2)), ltrim(rtrim(d.ESE_VALUE2))
			from inserted i, deleted d
			where i.ESE_SQLIDENTITY = d.ESE_SQLIDENTITY
			
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sREntity, @sAttributeSetDef, @sValue2, @sOldValue2
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sAttributeSetDef = N'S2XGLOBALID'
								and isnumeric(@sValue2) = 1 and isnumeric(@sOldValue2) = 1 
								begin
									set @nValue2 = convert(bigint, @sValue2)
									set @nOldValue2 = convert(bigint, @sOldValue2)
									
									if @nValue2 < @nOldValue2
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											RAISERROR( 'Variation ID out of sequence', 16, 1 )
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sREntity, @sAttributeSetDef, @sValue2, @sOldValue2
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.eta_arrangement,  i.eta_rtype, i.eta_rate, i.eta_trade, i.eta_org, 
														d.eta_arrangement, d.eta_rtype, d.eta_rate, d.eta_trade,d.eta_org,
														i.ETA_UPDATECOUNT, d.ETA_UPDATECOUNT, i.ETA_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.ETA_SQLIDENTITY = d.ETA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sArrangement, @sRtype, @sRate, @sTrade,@sOrg,
													@sOldArrangement, @sOldRtype, @sOldRate, @sOldTrade, @sOldOrg,
													@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							execute @nReturn = O7PREETA N'UPD', @sOldArrangement, @sOldRtype, @sOldRate, @sOldTrade, @sOldOrg,@sArrangement, @sRtype, @sRate, @sTrade,@sOrg

							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5EXTTARIFFS set ETA_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, ETA_LASTSAVED = getdate() where ETA_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sArrangement, @sRtype, @sRate, @sTrade,@sOrg,
															@sOldArrangement, @sOldRtype, @sOldRate, @sOldTrade,@sOldOrg,
															@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity

						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_ETT
ON r5entitytables
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @sUser			NVARCHAR(38)
	DECLARE @sCheckresult	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sOrgCode		NVARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @nReturn		INT

	-- Variables for the Old Record Values
	DECLARE @sOldRentity	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sOldMos		NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @nOldUpdCount	int
	DECLARE @iOldSQLIdent	INT

	-- Variables for the New Record Values
	DECLARE @sNewRentity	NVARCHAR(4)
	DECLARE @sNewMos		NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @nNewUpdCount	int

	-- If no records updated then bypass trigger processing
	IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		BEGIN
			SET NOCOUNT ON

			-- If User is SYS then bypass trigger processing
			SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
				BEGIN
					-- Cursor Declarations
					DECLARE c_Upd CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL FOR
						SELECT 	d.ett_rentity, 		i.ett_rentity,
								d.ett_mos,			i.ett_mos,
								d.ett_updatecount,	i.ett_updatecount,
								i.ett_sqlidentity
						FROM 	inserted i, deleted d
						WHERE	i.ett_sqlidentity = d.ett_sqlidentity

					DECLARE c_Org CURSOR LOCAL SCROLL FOR
						SELECT org_code FROM r5organization

					-- Open Cursors
					OPEN c_Upd

					OPEN c_Org

					FETCH NEXT
					FROM	c_Upd
					INTO	@sOldRentity,	@sNewRentity,
							@sOldMos,		@sNewMos,
							@nOldUpdCount,	@nNewUpdCount,
							@iOldSQLIdent

				-- Process Each Updated Row
				WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
					BEGIN
						-- Not possible to go from mos 'ON' to 'OFF'
						IF @sOldMos = N'+' AND @sNewMos = N'-'
							BEGIN
								CLOSE c_Org
								DEALLOCATE c_Org
								CLOSE c_Upd
								DEALLOCATE c_Upd
								EXECUTE O7RAE N'PREUPD_ETT', N'TRIG', '1', @@ERROR
								ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
								RETURN
							END


						/* Not possible to go to mos 'ON' for certain entities */
						/*IF @sOldMos = N'-' AND @sNewMos = N'+' AND @sOldRentity = N'BBNT'
							begin
								CLOSE c_Org
								DEALLOCATE c_Org
								CLOSE c_Upd
								DEALLOCATE c_Upd
								EXECUTE O7RAE N'PREUPD_ETT', N'TRIG', '2', @@ERROR
								ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
								RETURN
							end*/

						-- If mos is set to 'ON' for 'CLAS', copy classes
						IF  @sNewRentity = N'CLAS' AND
							@sOldMos = N'-' AND
							@sNewMos = N'+'
							BEGIN
								FETCH FIRST FROM c_Org INTO @sOrgCode
								WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
									BEGIN
									-- Copy Classes
										EXECUTE @nReturn = o7cpclas @sOrgCode, N'PREUPD_ETT'
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												CLOSE c_Org
												DEALLOCATE c_Org
												CLOSE c_Upd
												DEALLOCATE c_Upd
												ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
												RETURN
											end
										FETCH NEXT FROM c_Org INTO @sOrgCode
									END
							END

						UPDATE r5entitytables SET ett_updated = GetDate() WHERE ett_sqlidentity = @iOldSQLIdent


						-- Increment the UpdateCount field
						IF COALESCE(@nOldUpdCount, -1) <> COALESCE(@nNewUpdCount, -1)
							BEGIN
								CLOSE c_Org
								DEALLOCATE c_Org
								CLOSE c_Upd
								DEALLOCATE c_Upd
								EXECUTE O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', '1', @@ERROR
								ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
								RETURN
							END
						ELSE
							BEGIN
								UPDATE r5entitytables
									SET ett_updatecount = isnull(ett_updatecount, -1) + 1
									WHERE ett_sqlidentity = @iOldSQLIdent
							END

						-- If an entity is turned on, then update r5pagecache to cause all pages to be regenerated
						IF( @sNewMos = N'+' )
							BEGIN
								UPDATE r5pagecache SET pgc_updatecount = pgc_updatecount
							END

						FETCH NEXT
						FROM	c_Upd
						INTO	@sOldRentity,	@sNewRentity,
								@sOldMos,		@sNewMos,
								@nOldUpdCount,	@nNewUpdCount,
								@iOldSQLIdent
					END
				CLOSE c_Org
				DEALLOCATE c_Org
				CLOSE c_Upd
				DEALLOCATE c_Upd
			END
		END
END

			SET NOCOUNT ON

													  	i.EVA_RSTATUS,	i.EVA_SUPPLIER,	i.EVA_ORDER,	i.EVA_EVENT,	i.EVA_ACT,

													 ,
													  	d.EVA_NO,	d.EVA_DESC,	d.EVA_DATE,	d.EVA_CLASS,	d.EVA_STATUS,
													  	d.EVA_RSTATUS,	d.EVA_SUPPLIER,	d.EVA_ORDER,	d.EVA_EVENT,	d.EVA_ACT,

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del

											@sOldClass_org,	@sOldSupplier_org,	@sOldOrder_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							if @sOldRstatus = N'C'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_EVA', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF @sOldRstatus NOT IN (N'U',N'C') AND
								(@sOldClass			<> @sClass OR
								@sOldClass_org		<> @sClass_org OR
								@sOldSupplier		<> @sSupplier OR
								@sOldSupplier_org	<> @sSupplier_org OR
								@sOldOrder			<> @sOrder OR
								@sOldOrder_org		<> @sOrder_org OR
								(@sOldEvent			<> @sEvent AND @nOldAct <> @nAct) OR

									deallocate c_ins_del

									return
								end

								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREEVA', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end



			
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1

								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'EVAL', @sX, N'*', @sOldNo, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND  (@sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass,N'*') 
							OR @sClass_org <> coalesce(@sOldClass_org,@sDeforg))
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues

								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldNo



						end
					update R5SUPPEVALUATION set	EVA_NO            =  @sNo,	EVA_DESC          =  @sDesc,	EVA_DATE          =  @dDate,
						                       	EVA_CLASS         =  @sClass,	EVA_STATUS        =  @sStatus,	EVA_RSTATUS       =  @sRstatus,

						                       	EVA_USERGROUP     =  @sUsergroup,	EVA_CODE          =  @sCode,	EVA_RATING        =  @nRating,
						                       	EVA_CLASS_ORG     =  @sClass_org,	EVA_SUPPLIER_ORG  =  @sSupplier_org,	EVA_ORDER_ORG     =  @sOrder_org,

create trigger PREUPD_EVD
on R5SUPPEVALCODES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for
					select	i.EVD_CODE, i.EVD_DESC, i.EVD_CLASS, i.EVD_CLASS_ORG , i.EVD_UPDATECOUNT,
							d.EVD_CODE, d.EVD_CLASS, d.EVD_CLASS_ORG , d.EVD_UPDATECOUNT, i.EVD_SQLIDENTITY
					from	inserted i, deleted d
					where	i.EVD_SQLIDENTITY = d.EVD_SQLIDENTITY

			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCode,
													@sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							execute @nReturn = O7PREEVD @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREEVD', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5SUPPEVALCODES
									set		EVD_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, EVD_LASTSAVED = getdate()
									where	EVD_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'EVCD', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF	Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass, N'*')
								OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'EVCD'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCode,
															@sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

						select @nCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@EMPEXCP'
							if @nCount > 0
								select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@EMPEXCP'
							else
								set @sFlag = N'N'
								if @sFlag = N'Y'
								begin
								select @sOrg = PER_ORG from  R5PERSONNEL WHERE PER_CODE = @sPerson
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_inserted
										deallocate c_inserted
										rollback transaction
										return
									end					
							
									INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
									  (XTS_TRANTYPE,
										  XTS_TABLE,
										  XTS_KEYFLD1,
										  XTS_KEYFLD2,
										  XTS_KEYFLDDATE1,
										  XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID,
										  XTS_ORG
									  )
									  VALUES(
										 N'EMPEXCPN',
										 N'R5EXCEPTIONS',
										 @sPerson,
										 CAST(@nTime as varchar(80)),
										 @dDate,
										 @sTempMsgid,
										 @sOrg
										 )
							end
-- UPDATE EAM-801 END
						
							if @dDate <> @dOldDate 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end 
							

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5EXCEPTIONS set EXC_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, EXC_LASTSAVED = getdate() where EXC_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sPerson, @dDate, @nUpdatecount, @sOldPerson, @dOldDate,  @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @nTime  
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_EXP
ON r5export
FOR UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sqlidentity INT
  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE upd CURSOR LOCAL FOR
        SELECT exp_sqlidentity
        FROM   inserted
      OPEN upd
      FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          UPDATE r5export
          SET    exp_lastsaved = getdate()
          WHERE  exp_sqlidentity = @sqlidentity
          FETCH NEXT FROM upd INTO @sqlidentity
        END
      CLOSE upd
      DEALLOCATE upd
    END

create trigger PREUPD_FAC
on R5FACILITIES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(10)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.FAC_CODE, i.FAC_ORG, i.FAC_DESC, i.FAC_CLASS, i.FAC_CLASS_ORG , i.FAC_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.FAC_CODE, d.FAC_ORG, d.FAC_DESC, d.FAC_CLASS, d.FAC_CLASS_ORG , d.FAC_UPDATECOUNT, i.FAC_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.FAC_SQLIDENTITY = d.FAC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_FAC', N'TRIG', 4
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'FAC', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_FAC', N'TRIG', 3
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
										
									end

							--PREUPD2_FAC portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5FACILITIES set FAC_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, FAC_LASTSAVED = getdate() where FAC_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSUPD_FAC portion
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'FAC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'FAC'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldOrg,@sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_FAL
on R5FAILURES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.FAL_CODE, i.FAL_DESC, i.FAL_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.FAL_CODE, d.FAL_DESC, d.FAL_UPDATECOUNT, i.FAL_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.FAL_SQLIDENTITY = d.FAL_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'1'
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update R5FAILURES set FAL_UPDATED = GetDate() where FAL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--PREUPD2_FAL portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5FAILURES set FAL_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where FAL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--POSUPD_FAL portion
							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'FAIL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
		
								fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_FCA
on R5FAILURECLASSES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sFailure			nvarchar(8)  
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldFailure		nvarchar(8)  


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.FCA_CLASS, i.FCA_CLASS_ORG, i.FCA_FAILURE, i.FCA_UPDATECOUNT, i.FCA_SQLIDENTITY,  
														d.FCA_CLASS, d.FCA_CLASS_ORG, d.FCA_FAILURE, d.FCA_UPDATECOUNT 
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.FCA_SQLIDENTITY = d.FCA_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sClass, @sClassOrg, @sFailure, @nUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,
													@sOldFailure, @nOldUpdateCount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							/* W43351 - Code and Class not updateable */
							if @sClass		<> @sOldClass	OR
							   @sClassOrg	<> @sOldClassOrg	OR
							   @sFailure		<> @sOldFailure
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
									update R5FAILURECLASSES set FCA_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
															where FCA_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
								else
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sClass,@sClassOrg,@sFailure, @nUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity, @sOldClass,
															@sOldClassOrg, @sOldFailure, @nOldUpdateCount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()

						end

create trigger PREUPD_FND
on R5FINDINGS
instead of update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass      		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sGen        		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sClass_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @dCreated    		datetime            
	declare @dUpdated    		datetime            
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldGen        	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @dOldCreated    	datetime            
	declare @dOldUpdated    	datetime  
	
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE	          

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.FND_CODE,	i.FND_DESC,	i.FND_CLASS,	i.FND_GEN,	i.FND_CLASS_ORG,
													 	i.FND_UPDATECOUNT,	i.FND_CREATED,	i.FND_UPDATED,	i.FND_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.FND_CODE,	d.FND_DESC,	d.FND_CLASS,	d.FND_GEN,	d.FND_CLASS_ORG,
													  	d.FND_UPDATECOUNT,	d.FND_CREATED,	d.FND_UPDATED
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.FND_SQLIDENTITY = d.FND_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sGen,	@sClass_org,
										   	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldGen,	@sOldClass_org,
											@nOldUpdatecount,	@dOldCreated,	@dOldUpdated
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							If @sClass is not null AND @sClass<> coalesce(@sOldClass, N'*') OR @sClass_org <> coalesce (@sOldClass_org, @sDeforg)
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'FIND', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_FND', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

								end

							set @dUpdated = GetDate()
			
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'FIND', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND  (@sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass,N'*') 
							OR @sClass_org <> coalesce(@sOldClass_org,@sDeforg))
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'FIND'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode


						end
					update R5FINDINGS set	FND_CODE         =  @sCode,	FND_DESC         =  @sDesc,	FND_CLASS        =  @sClass,
						                 	FND_GEN          =  @sGen,	FND_CLASS_ORG    =  @sClass_org,	FND_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount,
						                 	FND_CREATED      =  @dCreated,	FND_UPDATED      =  @dUpdated
						where FND_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sGen,	@sClass_org,
												   	@nUpdatecount,	@dCreated,	@dUpdated,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldGen,	@sOldClass_org,
													@nOldUpdatecount,	@dOldCreated,	@dOldUpdated
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @nAmount       		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sBillsubline  		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sComment      		nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @sExtracharge  		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nUpdatecount  		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity  		integer             

	declare @sOldPk           	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldTicket       	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldException    	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldException_org	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @dOldDate         	datetime            
	declare @sOldEvent        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldType         	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @nOldAmount       	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sOldBillsubline  	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @sOldComment      	nvarchar(2000)      
	declare @sOldExtracharge  	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOldUpdatecount  	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.FTE_PK,	i.FTE_TICKET,	i.FTE_EXCEPTION,	i.FTE_EXCEPTION_ORG,
														i.FTE_DATE,	i.FTE_EVENT,	i.FTE_TYPE,	i.FTE_AMOUNT,
														i.FTE_BILLSUBLINE,	i.FTE_COMMENT,	i.FTE_EXTRACHARGE,	i.FTE_UPDATECOUNT,	i.FTE_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.FTE_PK,	d.FTE_TICKET,	d.FTE_EXCEPTION,	d.FTE_EXCEPTION_ORG,
													  	d.FTE_DATE,	d.FTE_EVENT,	d.FTE_TYPE,	d.FTE_AMOUNT,
													  	d.FTE_BILLSUBLINE,	d.FTE_COMMENT,	d.FTE_EXTRACHARGE,	d.FTE_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.FTE_SQLIDENTITY = d.FTE_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del
					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sPk,	@sTicket,	@sException,	@sException_org,
													@dDate,	@sEvent,	@sType,	@nAmount,
													@sBillsubline,	@sComment,	@sExtracharge,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldPk,	@sOldTicket,	@sOldException,	@sOldException_org,
													@dOldDate,	@sOldEvent,	@sOldType,	@nOldAmount,
													@sOldBillsubline,	@sOldComment,	@sOldExtracharge,	@nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							
                            IF @sTicket <> @sOldTicket OR @sException <> @sOldException
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update r5fleetticketexceptions set FTE_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, FTE_LASTSAVED = getdate() where FTE_SQLIDENTITY		= @nSqlidentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sPk,	@sTicket,	@sException,	@sException_org,
															@dDate,	@sEvent,	@sType,	@nAmount,
															@sBillsubline,	@sComment,	@sExtracharge,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
															@sOldPk,	@sOldTicket,	@sOldException,	@sOldException_org,
															@dOldDate,	@sOldEvent,	@sOldType,	@nOldAmount,
															@sOldBillsubline,	@sOldComment,	@sOldExtracharge,	@nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_FUN
on R5FUNCTIONS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPerType			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(6)
	declare @sSubType			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sSystem			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFilterOrg         nvarchar(15)
	declare @sFilterClass       nvarchar(8)
	declare @sFilterClassOrg    nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldPerType		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(6)
	declare @sOldSubType		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldSystem			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldFilterOrg      nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldFilterClass    nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldFilterClassOrg nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.FUN_CLASS, i.FUN_CLASS_ORG, i.FUN_PERTYPE, i.FUN_DESC, i.FUN_CODE, i.FUN_SUBTYPE, i.FUN_SYSTEM, i.FUN_FIELDFILTERCFCLASS, i.FUN_FIELDFILTERCFCLASS_ORG, i.FUN_FIELDFILTERCFORG,
														d.FUN_CLASS, d.FUN_CLASS_ORG, d.FUN_PERTYPE, d.FUN_DESC, d.FUN_CODE, d.FUN_SUBTYPE, d.FUN_SYSTEM, d.FUN_FIELDFILTERCFCLASS, d.FUN_FIELDFILTERCFCLASS_ORG, d.FUN_FIELDFILTERCFORG,
														i.FUN_UPDATECOUNT, d.FUN_UPDATECOUNT
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.FUN_SQLIDENTITY = d.FUN_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sClass, @sClassOrg, @sPerType, @sDesc, @sCode, @sSubType, @sSystem, @sFilterClass, @sFilterClassOrg, @sFilterOrg,
													@sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldPerType, @sOldDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldSubType, @sOldSystem, @sOldFilterClass, @sOldFilterClassOrg, @sOldFilterOrg,
													@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @sCode		<> @sOldCode	OR
							   @sSystem		<> @sOldSystem
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sSystem = N'+'
								begin
									if @sClass <> @sOldClass OR @sClassOrg <> @sOldClassOrg
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if @sPerType <> @sOldPerType and @sPerType is not null
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'ENT', N'PRTP', @sPerType, @sX, N'UCOD', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											--this is an educated guess that something else is catching "db_error" exceptions
											--  the same way that the other objects we have converted have done which is this statement below
											execute O7RAE N'PREINS_FUN', N'TRIG', N'2', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
								update R5FUNCTIONS set FUN_DESCCHANGED = N'+' where FUN_CODE = @sCode

							if coalesce(@nUpdatecount, -1) = coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1)
									update r5functions set fun_updatecount = coalesce(@nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
									  where FUN_CODE	= @sCode
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1'
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							if @sDesc <> @sOldDesc
								begin
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'FUNC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

                            /* If Field Filter Setup Class was changed, then cleanup custom fields from r5pagelayout and bump page layout cache */
                            IF (COALESCE(@sOldFilterClass, 'x') <> COALESCE(@sFilterClass, 'x') OR 
                                COALESCE(@sOldFilterClassOrg, 'x') <> COALESCE(@sFilterClassOrg, 'x') OR
                                COALESCE(@sOldFilterOrg, 'x') <> COALESCE(@sFilterOrg, 'x'))
                              begin
                                DELETE FROM r5pagelayout
                                WHERE plo_pagename = @sCode
                                AND (plo_elementid LIKE 'cust_2%' OR plo_elementid LIKE 'cust_3%')

                                UPDATE r5pagecache
                                SET    pgc_updatecount = pgc_updatecount
                                WHERE  pgc_function = @sCode
                                AND    pgc_tabname = 'HDR'
                              end

							update r5functions set FUN_UPDATED = getdate(),
								fun_displayft = case when fun_auto = N'I' then N'-' when fun_auto in ( N'D', N'N', N'M', N'L' ) then N'+' else fun_displayft end
							where FUN_CODE	= @sCode
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into	@sClass, @sClassOrg, @sPerType, @sDesc, @sCode, @sSubType, @sSystem, @sFilterClass, @sFilterClassOrg, @sFilterOrg,
															@sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldPerType, @sOldDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldSubType, @sOldSystem, @sOldFilterClass, @sOldFilterClassOrg, @sOldFilterOrg,
															@nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end


-- ========================================

				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sX = NULL
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'

							execute @nReturn = O7PREFUS N'INS', @sUser, @sShortn, @sFunction, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 							
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
								
							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREFUS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


						end

					update R5FUNCUSERS set	FUS_FUNCTION     =  @sFunction,	FUS_USER         =  @sUser,	FUS_SHORTN       =  @sShortn,
						                  	FUS_PRINTER      =  @sPrinter,	FUS_BUTFUN1      =  @sButfun1,	FUS_BUTFUN2      =  @sButfun2,
						                  	FUS_BUTFUN3      =  @sButfun3,	FUS_BUTFUN4      =  @sButfun4,	FUS_BUTFUN5      =  @sButfun5,
						                  	FUS_BUTFUN6      =  @sButfun6,	FUS_BUTNAME1     =  @sButname1,	FUS_BUTNAME2     =  @sButname2,
						                  	FUS_BUTNAME3     =  @sButname3,	FUS_BUTNAME4     =  @sButname4,	FUS_BUTNAME5     =  @sButname5,
						                  	FUS_BUTNAME6     =  @sButname6,	FUS_BUTICON1     =  @sButicon1,	FUS_BUTICON2     =  @sButicon2,
						                  	FUS_BUTICON3     =  @sButicon3,	FUS_BUTICON4     =  @sButicon4,	FUS_BUTICON5     =  @sButicon5,
						                  	FUS_BUTICON6     =  @sButicon6,	FUS_NOTES        =  @sNotes,	FUS_FILTER       =  @sFilter,
						                  	FUS_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, FUS_LASTSAVED =  getdate()
						where FUS_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sFunction,	@sUser,	@sShortn,	@sPrinter,	@sButfun1,
												   	@sButfun2,	@sButfun3,	@sButfun4,	@sButfun5,	@sButfun6,
												   	@sButname1,	@sButname2,	@sButname3,	@sButname4,	@sButname5,
												   	@sButname6,	@sButicon1,	@sButicon2,	@sButicon3,	@sButicon4,
												   	@sButicon5,	@sButicon6,	@sNotes,	@sFilter,	@nUpdatecount,
												   	@nSqlidentity,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_GFD
on R5GRIDFIELD
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdateCount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nFieldId			int
	declare @nGridId			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.GFD_UPDATECOUNT, d.GFD_UPDATECOUNT, i.GFD_FIELDID, i.GFD_GRIDID
										   from inserted i, deleted d
										  where i.GFD_SQLIDENTITY	= d.GFD_SQLIDENTITY

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nFieldId, @nGridId
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							if @nOldUpdateCount is null
								update	R5GRIDFIELD 
								   set	GFD_UPDATECOUNT = 1 
								 where	GFD_FIELDID	= @nFieldId	AND
										GFD_GRIDID	= @nGridId
							else
								begin
									if @nUpdateCount = @nOldUpdateCount
										update R5GRIDFIELD 
										   set GFD_UPDATECOUNT = GFD_UPDATECOUNT + 1 
										 where	GFD_FIELDID	= @nFieldId	AND
												GFD_GRIDID	= @nGridId
									else
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											--this is an educated guess that something else is catching "db_error" exceptions
											--  the same way that the other objects we have converted have done which is this statement below
											execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
											rollback transaction
										end
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdateCount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nFieldId, @nGridId
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_HEL
on R5HELPTEXTS
instead of update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sFunction   		nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sItem       		nvarchar(24)        
	declare @sText       		nvarchar(250)       
	declare @sLang       		nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sPool       		nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sDrilldown  		nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sChanged    		nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldFunction   	nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sOldItem       	nvarchar(24)        
	declare @sOldText       	nvarchar(250)       
	declare @sOldLang       	nvarchar(2)         
	declare @sOldPool       	nvarchar(12)        
	declare @sOldDrilldown  	nvarchar(6)         
	declare @sOldChanged    	nvarchar(1)         
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)   
	
	declare @sDevt				nvarchar(1)    

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.HEL_FUNCTION,	i.HEL_ITEM,	i.HEL_TEXT,	i.HEL_LANG,	i.HEL_POOL,
													 	i.HEL_DRILLDOWN,	i.HEL_CHANGED,	i.HEL_UPDATECOUNT,	i.HEL_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.HEL_FUNCTION,	d.HEL_ITEM,	d.HEL_TEXT,	d.HEL_LANG,	d.HEL_POOL,
													  	d.HEL_DRILLDOWN,	d.HEL_CHANGED,	d.HEL_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.HEL_SQLIDENTITY = d.HEL_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sFunction,	@sItem,	@sText,	@sLang,	@sPool,
										   	@sDrilldown,	@sChanged,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldFunction,	@sOldItem,	@sOldText,	@sOldLang,	@sOldPool,
											@sOldDrilldown,	@sOldChanged,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							SELECT @sDevt = SUBSTRING( ins_desc, 1, 1 )
							FROM   r5install
							WHERE  ins_code = N'KEEPBOT'

							IF @sDevt = N'+' 
								set @sChanged = N'+'

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5HELPTEXTS set	HEL_FUNCTION     =  @sFunction,	HEL_ITEM         =  @sItem,	HEL_TEXT         =  @sText,
						                  	HEL_LANG         =  @sLang,	HEL_POOL         =  @sPool,	HEL_DRILLDOWN    =  @sDrilldown,
						                  	HEL_CHANGED      =  @sChanged,	HEL_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, HEL_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						where HEL_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sFunction,	@sItem,	@sText,	@sLang,	@sPool,
												   	@sDrilldown,	@sChanged,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldFunction,	@sOldItem,	@sOldText,	@sOldLang,	@sOldPool,
													@sOldDrilldown,	@sOldChanged,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_IND
on R5INDICATORS
instead of update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sSysUser			nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode       		nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sDesc       		nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sClass      		nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sUom        		nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nMin        		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nMax        		numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sClass_org  		nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nUpdatecount		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nSqlidentity		integer             

	declare @sOldCode       	nvarchar(4)         
	declare @sOldDesc       	nvarchar(80)        
	declare @sOldClass      	nvarchar(8)         
	declare @sOldUom        	nvarchar(30)        
	declare @nOldMin        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @nOldMax        	numeric(24,6)       
	declare @sOldClass_org  	nvarchar(15)        
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	numeric(38,0)  
	
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @nCountit		int
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)	
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE	    	     

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.IND_CODE,	i.IND_DESC,	i.IND_CLASS,	i.IND_UOM,	i.IND_MIN,
													 	i.IND_MAX,	i.IND_CLASS_ORG,	i.IND_UPDATECOUNT,	i.IND_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.IND_CODE,	d.IND_DESC,	d.IND_CLASS,	d.IND_UOM,	d.IND_MIN,
													  	d.IND_MAX,	d.IND_CLASS_ORG,	d.IND_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.IND_SQLIDENTITY = d.IND_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sUom,	@nMin,
										   	@nMax,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldUom,	@nOldMin,
											@nOldMax,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0


							if @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							If @sClass is not null AND @sClass<> coalesce(@sOldClass, N'*') OR @sClass_org <> coalesce (@sOldClass_org, @sDeforg)
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'IND', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_IND', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

								end
			
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'IND', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end


							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND  (@sOldClass <> coalesce(@sClass,N'*') 
							OR @sClass_org <> coalesce(@sOldClass_org,@sDeforg))
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'IND'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode


						end
					update R5INDICATORS set	IND_CODE         =  @sCode,	IND_DESC         =  @sDesc,	IND_CLASS        =  @sClass,
						                   	IND_UOM          =  @sUom,	IND_MIN          =  @nMin,	IND_MAX          =  @nMax,
						                   	IND_CLASS_ORG    =  @sClass_org,	IND_UPDATECOUNT  =  @nUpdatecount, IND_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						where IND_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@sCode,	@sDesc,	@sClass,	@sUom,	@nMin,
												   	@nMax,	@sClass_org,	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@sOldCode,	@sOldDesc,	@sOldClass,	@sOldUom,	@nOldMin,
													@nOldMax,	@sOldClass_org,	@nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_IPV
on R5IPVENDORS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nCode				integer
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @sCheckresult	nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX				nvarchar(1)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select  i.IPV_CODE, i.IPV_DESC, i.IPV_ORG, i.IPV_UPDATECOUNT, d.IPV_UPDATECOUNT, i.IPV_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.IPV_SQLIDENTITY = d.IPV_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sX = null

			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							set @sDesc = Substring(@sDesc, 1, 45)
							set @sCode = cast(@nCode as nvarchar(38))

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'IPVN', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_inserted
									deallocate c_inserted
									execute O7RAE N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5IPVENDORS set IPV_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, IPV_LASTSAVED = getdate() where IPV_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nCode, @sDesc, @sOrg, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_LAN
on R5LANGUAGES
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(2)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(2)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)
declare @nError		int


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.LAN_CODE, i.LAN_DESC, i.LAN_CLASS, i.LAN_CLASS_ORG , i.LAN_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.LAN_CODE, d.LAN_DESC, d.LAN_CLASS, d.LAN_CLASS_ORG , d.LAN_UPDATECOUNT, i.LAN_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.LAN_SQLIDENTITY = d.LAN_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end


								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'LANG', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del

						end

				end

CREATE TRIGGER PREUPD_LHK
ON r5localehotkeys
INSTEAD OF UPDATE
NOT FOR REPLICATION
AS
  DECLARE @sUser          NVARCHAR( 38 )

  DECLARE @sLocale        NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @sCode          NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sDesc          NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @nDefault       INTEGER
  DECLARE @nKey           INTEGER
  DECLARE @sExtra         NVARCHAR( 5 )
  DECLARE @nSqlidentity	  INTEGER

  DECLARE @sOldLocale     NVARCHAR( 10 )
  DECLARE @sOldCode       NVARCHAR( 30 )
  DECLARE @sOldDesc       NVARCHAR( 80 )
  DECLARE @nOldDefault    INTEGER
  DECLARE @nOldKey        INTEGER
  DECLARE @sOldExtra      NVARCHAR( 5 )

  IF @@ROWCOUNT > 0
    BEGIN
      SET NOCOUNT ON
      DECLARE c_ins_del cursor LOCAL FOR 
        SELECT i.lhk_locale, i.lhk_code, i.lhk_desc, i.lhk_default, i.lhk_key, i.lhk_extra, i.lhk_sqlidentity,
               d.lhk_locale, d.lhk_code, d.lhk_desc, d.lhk_default, d.lhk_key, d.lhk_extra
        FROM   inserted i, deleted d
        WHERE  i.lhk_sqlidentity = d.lhk_sqlidentity
      SET @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
      OPEN c_ins_del
      FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del 
      INTO @sLocale, @sCode, @sDesc, @nDefault, @nKey, @sExtra, @nSqlidentity,
           @sOldLocale, @sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @nOldDefault, @nOldKey, @sOldExtra
      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
        BEGIN
          IF @sUser <> N'SYS'
            BEGIN
              IF ISNULL( @sLocale,  N'a' ) <> ISNULL( @sOldLocale, N'a' ) OR
                 ISNULL( @sCode,    N'a' ) <> ISNULL( @sOldCode,   N'a' ) OR
                 ISNULL( @sDesc,    N'a' ) <> ISNULL( @sOldDesc,   N'a' ) OR
                 ISNULL( @nDefault,   -1 ) <> ISNULL( @nOldDefault,  -1 ) OR
                 ISNULL( @sExtra,   N'a' ) <> ISNULL( @sOldExtra,  N'a' )
                BEGIN
                  CLOSE c_ins_del
                  DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
                  EXECUTE O7RAE N'PREUPD_LHK', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
                  ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
                  RETURN
                END

                UPDATE r5localehotkeys
                SET    lhk_key = @nKey
                WHERE  lhk_sqlidentity = @nSqlidentity
 
                FETCH NEXT FROM c_ins_del 
                INTO @sLocale, @sCode, @sDesc, @nDefault, @nKey, @sExtra, @nSqlidentity,
                     @sOldLocale, @sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @nOldDefault, @nOldKey, @sOldExtra

            END
 
          CLOSE c_ins_del
          DEALLOCATE c_ins_del
        END
    END

create trigger PREUPD_LOT

for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser			nvarchar(38)

	declare @sDeforg		nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @sCode			nvarchar(12)
	declare @sClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldCode		nvarchar(12)
	declare @sOldClass		nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg	nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nReturn		int
	declare @nSqlIdentity	int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for	select	i.LOT_CODE, i.LOT_CLASS, i.LOT_CLASS_ORG, i.LOT_DESC, i.LOT_UPDATECOUNT, 
														d.LOT_CODE, d.LOT_CLASS, d.LOT_CLASS_ORG, d.LOT_UPDATECOUNT, i.LOT_SQLIDENTITY
												from	inserted i, deleted d
												where	i.LOT_SQLIDENTITY = d.LOT_SQLIDENTITY
			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					deallocate c_ins_del
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @nCountit = 0
							set @sX = NULL

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sClass is not null and 
							 ( @sClass <> coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) OR 
							   @sClassOrg <> coalesce( @sOldClassOrg, @sDeforg ) ) 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'LOT', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_LOT', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end


								if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull(@nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
									update R5LOTS set LOT_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, LOT_LASTSAVED = getdate() where LOT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
								else
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
										rollback transaction
										return
									end
							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'LOT', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*') <> N'*' AND
							 ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) OR
							   @sOldClassOrg <> coalesce( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'LOT'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sDesc, @nUpdatecount, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

					return
				end

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOrg, @sDesc,@nUpdateCount,@nSqlIdentity, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdateCount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL
							set @nCountit = 0

							if @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
								begin
									if @sCode <> @sOldCode
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sClass is not null and 
									 ( @sClass <> coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) OR 
									   @sClassOrg <> coalesce( @sOldClassOrg, @sDeforg ) ) 
										begin
											execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'MET', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											if @nCountit = 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_MET', N'TRIG', 1
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end

							update R5METERS set MET_UPDATED = GetDate() where MET_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							if isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update R5METERS set MET_updatecount = isnull( @nUpdateCount, -1) + 1 where MET_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
							
							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
 							if @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
 								begin
									set @sCheckresult = N'0'
									set @sX = NULL

									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'MET', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*') <> N'*' AND
									 ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) OR
									   @sOldClassOrg <> coalesce( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
										DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
										WHERE prv_rentity     = N'MET'
										AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
										AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
										AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								end
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOrg, @sDesc,@nUpdateCount,@nSqlIdentity, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdateCount						
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end
