create trigger PREUPD_MFG
on R5MANUFACTURERS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(24)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(24)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @sFlag              nvarchar(1)
	declare @sTempMsgid         nvarchar(256)
	declare @sCount				int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.MFG_CODE, i.MFG_CLASS, i.MFG_CLASS_ORG, i.MFG_ORG, i.MFG_DESC,
														d.MFG_CODE, d.MFG_CLASS, d.MFG_CLASS_ORG, d.MFG_ORG,
														i.MFG_UPDATECOUNT, d.MFG_UPDATECOUNT
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.MFG_SQLIDENTITY = d.MFG_SQLIDENTITY

			execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
			if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
				begin
					deallocate c_ins_del
					rollback transaction
					return
				end

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldOrg, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL
							
							
							
							/*  OUTBOUND MANUFACTURER BEGIN EAM 5224*/
									select @sCount = count(*) from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@MANUFAC'
                                    if @sCount > 0
                                        select @sFlag = coalesce(ins_desc, N'N') from  R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@MANUFAC'
                                    else
                                        set @sFlag = N'N'

										EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_inserted
												deallocate c_inserted
												rollback transaction
												return
											end					
									
                                    if @sFlag = N'Y'
                                        begin
                                            INSERT INTO r5xmltranstatus(
												xts_trantype,
												xts_table,
												xts_keyfld1,
												xts_keyfld2,
												xts_orig_messageid,
												xts_org  )
												VALUES(
												 N'MANUFACTURER',
												 N'R5MANUFACTURERS',
												 @sCode,
												 @sOrg,
												 @sTempMsgid,
												 @sOrg )
                                        end
									/*  OUTBOUND MANUFACTURER END EAM 5224*/
							
							
							
							
							
							

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sClass is not null and 
							 ( @sClass <> coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) OR 
							   @sClassOrg <> coalesce( @sOldClassOrg, @sDeforg ) ) 
								begin
									execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'MANU', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @nCountit = 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_MFG', N'TRIG', 3
											rollback transaction
											return
										end
								end

							if coalesce(@nUpdatecount, -1) = coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1)
									update r5manufacturers set mfg_updatecount = coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1) + 1, mfg_updated = GetDate()
									 where	MFG_CODE	= @sCode
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1'
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'MANU', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*') <> N'*' AND
							 ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) OR
							   @sOldClassOrg <> coalesce( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'MANU'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode + N'#' + @sOldOrg
							
							
							
							
							
							
							
							
							
							
							
							
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldOrg, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
			end

create trigger PREUPD_MLP
on R5MATLPARTS
instead of update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sMatlist			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nLine				numeric(8)
	declare @sPart				nvarchar(30)
	declare @nQty				numeric(24,6)
	declare @sUom				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sReserv			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOptional			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCrit				nvarchar(1)
	declare @sObtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sObrtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(30)
	declare @sEquipFilter		nvarchar(500)
	declare @sDirect			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sReq				nvarchar(30)
	declare @nMatlrev			numeric(4)
	declare @sCode_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sPart_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nIdentity			int
	declare @sTrackrtype		nvarchar(4)

	declare @sOldMatlist		nvarchar(20)
	declare @nOldLine			numeric(8)
	declare @sOldPart			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldQty			numeric(24,6)
	declare @sOldUom			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldReserv			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldOptional		nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldCrit			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldObtype			nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldObrtype		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(30)
	declare @sOldEquipFilter	nvarchar(500)
	declare @sOldDirect			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sOldReq			nvarchar(30)
	declare @nOldMatlrev		numeric(4)
	declare @sOldCode_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldPart_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)
	declare @nReturn			int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.MLP_MATLIST, i.MLP_LINE, i.MLP_PART, i.MLP_QTY, i.MLP_UOM, i.MLP_RESERV, i.MLP_OPTIONAL,
														i.MLP_CRIT, i.MLP_OBTYPE, i.MLP_OBRTYPE, i.MLP_CODE, i.MLP_DIRECT, i.MLP_REQ,
														i.MLP_MATLREV, i.MLP_CODE_ORG, i.MLP_PART_ORG, i.MLP_UPDATECOUNT, i.MLP_SQLIDENTITY, i.MLP_EQUIPFILTER,
														d.MLP_MATLIST, d.MLP_LINE, d.MLP_PART, d.MLP_QTY, d.MLP_UOM, d.MLP_RESERV, d.MLP_OPTIONAL,
														d.MLP_CRIT, d.MLP_OBTYPE, d.MLP_OBRTYPE, d.MLP_CODE, d.MLP_DIRECT, d.MLP_REQ,
														d.MLP_MATLREV, d.MLP_CODE_ORG, d.MLP_PART_ORG, d.MLP_UPDATECOUNT, d.MLP_EQUIPFILTER
												from inserted i, deleted d
												where i.MLP_SQLIDENTITY = d.MLP_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into @sMatlist, @nLine, @sPart, @nQty, @sUom, @sReserv, @sOptional, @sCrit, @sObtype, @sObrtype,
											@sCode, @sDirect, @sReq, @nMatlrev, @sCode_org, @sPart_org, @nUpdatecount, @nIdentity, @sEquipFilter,
											@sOldMatlist, @nOldLine, @sOldPart, @nOldQty, @sOldUom, @sOldReserv, @sOldOptional, @sOldCrit, @sOldObtype, @sOldObrtype,
											@sOldCode, @sOldDirect, @sOldReq, @nOldMatlrev, @sOldCode_org, @sOldPart_org, @nOldUpdatecount, @sOldEquipFilter
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sUser <> N'SYS' and @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
						begin
							if @sMatlist <> @sOldMatlist or
							  @sObtype <> @sOldObtype or
							  @sObrtype <> @sOldObrtype or
							  @sCode <> @sOldCode or
							  @sCode_org <> @sOldCode_org
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1)
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end

					select @sTrackrtype = par_trackrtype from r5parts where PAR_CODE = @sPart and PAR_ORG = @sPart_org
					if @sTrackrtype = N'NOST'
						set @sDirect = N'+'

					update r5matlparts set MLP_MATLIST = @sMatlist, MLP_LINE = @nLine, MLP_PART = @sPart,
										MLP_QTY = @nQty, MLP_UOM = @sUom, MLP_RESERV = @sReserv, MLP_OPTIONAL = @sOptional,
										MLP_CRIT = @sCrit, MLP_OBTYPE = @sObtype, MLP_OBRTYPE = @sObrtype,
										MLP_CODE = @sCode, MLP_DIRECT = @sDirect, MLP_REQ = @sReq,
										MLP_MATLREV = @nMatlrev, MLP_CODE_ORG = @sCode_org, MLP_PART_ORG = @sPart_org,
										MLP_UPDATECOUNT = @nUpdatecount, MLP_EQUIPFILTER = @sEquipFilter, MLP_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						where mlp_sqlidentity = @nIdentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sMatlist, @nLine, @sPart, @nQty, @sUom, @sReserv, @sOptional, @sCrit, @sObtype, @sObrtype,
											@sCode, @sDirect, @sReq, @nMatlrev, @sCode_org, @sPart_org, @nUpdatecount, @nIdentity, @sEquipFilter,
											@sOldMatlist, @nOldLine, @sOldPart, @nOldQty, @sOldUom, @sOldReserv, @sOldOptional, @sOldCrit, @sOldObtype, @sOldObrtype,
											@sOldCode, @sOldDirect, @sOldReq, @nOldMatlrev, @sOldCode_org, @sOldPart_org, @nOldUpdatecount, @sOldEquipFilter
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_MMF
on R5MINMAXFORMULAS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.MMF_CODE, i.MMF_DESC, i.MMF_CLASS, i.MMF_CLASS_ORG , i.MMF_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.MMF_CODE, d.MMF_DESC, d.MMF_CLASS, d.MMF_CLASS_ORG , d.MMF_UPDATECOUNT, i.MMF_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.MMF_SQLIDENTITY = d.MMF_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							execute @nReturn = O7PREMMF N'UPD', @sClass , @sClassOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0 
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREMMF', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5MINMAXFORMULAS set MMF_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, MMF_LASTSAVED = getdate() where MMF_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'FORM', @sX, N'*', @sCode, N'*', @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( coalesce(@sOldClass,N'*') <> coalesce(@sClass, N'*') OR coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg) <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
								begin
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'FORM'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
								END
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg,@nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_MNG
on R5MINORITYGROUPS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(20)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.MNG_CODE, i.MNG_DESC, i.MNG_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.MNG_CODE, d.MNG_DESC, d.MNG_UPDATECOUNT, i.MNG_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.MNG_SQLIDENTITY = d.MNG_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin

							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7RAE N'PREUPD_MNG', N'TRIG', N'3', @@ERROR
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

							--PREUPD2_MNG portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5MINORITYGROUPS set MNG_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1, MNG_LASTSAVED = getdate() where MNG_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'MINO', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'O7DESCS', N'PROC', @sCheckresult
									rollback transaction
									return
								end
						
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@nUpdatecount, 
															@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_MRC
on R5MRCS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @sNotused			nvarchar(1)
	declare @sFlag				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sTempMsgid			nvarchar(256)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.MRC_CODE, i.MRC_CLASS, i.MRC_CLASS_ORG, i.MRC_ORG, i.MRC_DESC, i.MRC_NOTUSED,
														d.MRC_CODE, d.MRC_CLASS, d.MRC_CLASS_ORG, d.MRC_ORG, d.MRC_DESC,
														i.MRC_UPDATECOUNT, d.MRC_UPDATECOUNT
												  from	inserted i, deleted d
												 where	i.MRC_SQLIDENTITY = d.MRC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					--BEFORE EACH ROW portion
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sNotused, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							if @sCode <> @sOldCode
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7PREMRC N'UPD', @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if @sCheckresult <> N'0'
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'O7PREMRC', N'PROC', @sCheckresult, @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return

								end

							if coalesce(@nUpdatecount, -1) = coalesce(@nOldUpdatecount, -1)
									update r5mrcs set mrc_updatecount = coalesce(@nUpdatecount, -1) + 1,
														mrc_updated = GetDate()
									 where	MRC_CODE = @sCode
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1'
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = NULL

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'MRC', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							if coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*') <> N'*' AND
							 ( @sOldClass <> coalesce( @sClass, N'*' ) OR
							   @sOldClassOrg <> coalesce( @sClassOrg, @sDeforg ) )
								DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
								WHERE prv_rentity     = N'MRC'
								AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
								AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
								AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode + N'#' + @sOldOrg
							
							
							-- add Databridge event to r5xmltranstatus table
							SELECT @sFlag = isnull(INS_DESC, N'N') FROM R5INSTALL WHERE INS_CODE = N'@SYNCWO'
							if upper(@sFlag) = N'A'
							begin
								EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_GET_MESSAGEID @sTempMsgid OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

								INSERT INTO R5XMLTRANSTATUS
								(XTS_TRANTYPE,XTS_TABLE,XTS_KEYFLD1,XTS_KEYFLD2,XTS_KEYFLD3,XTS_ORG,XTS_ORIG_MESSAGEID)
								VALUES
								(N'CODEDEF',N'DEPARTMENT',@sCode,@sDesc,@sNotused,@sOrg,@sTempMsgid)
							end								
							
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sClass, @sClassOrg, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sNotused, @sOldCode, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdatecount
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)

	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClassOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClassOrg		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(4)


	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.MTH_CODE, i.MTH_DESC, i.MTH_CLASS, i.MTH_CLASS_ORG , i.MTH_UPDATECOUNT,
													  d.MTH_CODE, d.MTH_DESC, d.MTH_CLASS, d.MTH_CLASS_ORG , d.MTH_UPDATECOUNT, i.MTH_SQLIDENTITY
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.MTH_SQLIDENTITY = d.MTH_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sX = NULL
			set @nCountit = 0
			set @sCheckresult = N'0'

			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
													@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							IF @sCode <> @sOldCode 
								Begin
									execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								End

								execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
								if @@ERROR <> 0 OR @nReturn <> 0
									begin
										close c_ins_del
										deallocate c_ins_del
										rollback transaction
										return
									end

								If @sClass is not null AND (@sClass <> Coalesce(@sOldClass,'*') OR @sClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sOldClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									begin
										execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'METH', @sClass, @sClassOrg, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
										if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												rollback transaction
												return
											end

										if @nCountit = 0
											begin
												close c_ins_del
												deallocate c_ins_del
												execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_MTH', N'TRIG', 1
												rollback transaction
												return
											end
									end

							update R5METHODS set MTH_UPDATED = GetDate() where MTH_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

							--PREUPD2_MTH portion
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								update R5METHODS set MTH_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where MTH_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'METH', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sX, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
							if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							IF Coalesce( @sOldClass, N'*' ) <> N'*' AND ( @sOldClass  <> coalesce (@sClass, N'*') OR @sOldClassOrg <> Coalesce(@sClassOrg,@sDeforg)) 
									DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
									WHERE prv_rentity     = N'METH'
									AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
									AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClassOrg
									AND   prv_code        = @sOldCode
		
							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @sDesc,@sClass,@sClassOrg, @nUpdatecount, 
											@sOldCode, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClassOrg, @nOldUpdatecount, @nSqlIdentity
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_MTL
on R5MATLISTS
for update
NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @sCode				nvarchar(20)
	declare @nRevision			numeric(4)
	declare @sOrg				nvarchar(15)
	declare @sDesc				nvarchar(80)
	declare @sClass				nvarchar(8)
	declare @sClass_org			nvarchar(15)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @sEntity			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sPlan_record		nvarchar(20)

	declare @sOldCode			nvarchar(20)
	declare @nOldRevision		numeric(4)
	declare @sOldOrg			nvarchar(15)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldClass			nvarchar(8)
	declare @sOldClass_org		nvarchar(15)
	declare @nOldUpdatecount	int
	declare @sOldEntity			nvarchar(10)
	declare @sOldPlan_record	nvarchar(20)

	declare @sCheckresult		nvarchar(4)
	declare @sX					nvarchar(1)
	declare @nCountit			int
	declare @sDeforg			nvarchar(200)	--r5install.ins_desc%TYPE
	declare @nReturn			int
	declare @sChk				nvarchar(3)
	declare @sInobjectupdate	nvarchar(10)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.mtl_code, i.mtl_revision, i.mtl_org, i.mtl_desc, i.mtl_class, i.mtl_class_org, i.mtl_updatecount, i.mtl_entity, i.mtl_plan_record,
														d.mtl_code, d.mtl_revision, d.mtl_org, d.mtl_desc, d.mtl_class, d.mtl_class_org, d.mtl_updatecount, d.mtl_entity, d.mtl_plan_record
												from inserted i, deleted d
												where i.mtl_sqlidentity = d.mtl_sqlidentity
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @nRevision, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClass_org, @nUpdatecount, @sEntity, @sPlan_record,
													@sOldCode, @nOldRevision, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, @nOldUpdatecount, 
													@sOldEntity, @sOldPlan_record
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null
							set @nCountit = 0

							if @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7DFLT @sDeforg OUTPUT, N'DEFORG', @sChk OUTPUT
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sCode <> @sOldCode
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'R5', N'TRIG', 1
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if @sClass is not null and ( @sClass <> isnull(@sOldClass, N'*') or @sClass_org <> isnull( @sOldClass_org, @sDeforg ) )
										begin
											execute @nReturn = R5O7_O7EXIST N'CLAS', N'MATL', @sClass, @sClass_org, N'*', @sX, @sX, @sX, @sX, @nCountit OUTPUT, @sCheckresult OUTPUT
											if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													rollback transaction
													return
												end

											if @nCountit = 0
												begin
													close c_ins_del
													deallocate c_ins_del
													execute O7ERR_RAISE_ERROR N'PREUPD_MTL', N'TRIG', 1
													rollback transaction
													return
												end
										end
								end

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1)
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

							update r5matlists set mtl_updatecount = @nUpdatecount, MTL_LASTSAVED = getdate() where mtl_code = @sCode and mtl_revision = @nRevision

							--AFTER EACH ROW portion
							set @sCheckresult = N'0'
							set @sX = null

							if @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
								begin
									execute @nReturn = O7DESCS N'UPD', @sX, N'MATL', @sX, N'*', @sCode, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sCheckresult OUTPUT 
									if @@ERROR <> 0 or @nReturn <> 0
										begin
											close c_ins_del
											deallocate c_ins_del
											rollback transaction
											return
										end

									if isnull(@sOldClass, N'*') <> N'*' and ( @sOldClass <> isnull(@sClass, N'*') or @sOldClass_org <> isnull( @sClass_org, @sDeforg ) )
										DELETE FROM r5propertyvalues
										WHERE prv_rentity     = N'MATL'
										AND   prv_class       = @sOldClass
										AND   prv_class_org   = @sOldClass_org
										AND   prv_code        = @sCode + '#' + CAST( @nOldRevision as nvarchar(8) )
								end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @sCode, @nRevision, @sOrg, @sDesc, @sClass, @sClass_org, @nUpdatecount, @sEntity, @sPlan_record,
															@sOldCode, @nOldRevision, @sOldOrg, @sOldDesc, @sOldClass, @sOldClass_org, @nOldUpdatecount, @sOldEntity, @sOldPlan_record
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger PREUPD_OAC
on r5objactualconsumption
for update NOT FOR REPLICATION
as
	declare @sUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nUpdatecount		int
	declare @nOldUpdateCount	int
	declare @nSqlIdentity		int
    declare @sDesignusageuom    nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObject            nvarchar(30)
    declare @sObject_org        nvarchar(15)
    declare @sCommodity         nvarchar(30)
    declare @dDate              datetime
    declare @sInobjectupdate    nvarchar(10)
    declare @nReturn            int

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			EXECUTE @nReturn = O7SESS_CUR_INOBJECTUPDATE @sInobjectupdate OUTPUT
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select i.OAC_UPDATECOUNT, d.OAC_UPDATECOUNT, i.OAC_SQLIDENTITY,
                                                      i.oac_designusageuom, i.oac_object, i.oac_object_org,
                                                      i.oac_commodity, i.oac_date
											   from inserted i, deleted d
											  where i.OAC_SQLIDENTITY = d.OAC_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			if @sUser <> N'SYS'
				begin
					open c_ins_del 
					fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sDesignusageuom, 
                                                   @sObject, @sObject_org, @sCommodity, @dDate
					while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
						begin
                            --preup2_oac
							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdateCount, -1 )
								update r5objactualconsumption set OAC_UPDATECOUNT = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 where OAC_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

                            if @sInobjectupdate = N'FALSE'
                              begin
                                --preupd_oac
                                if @sDesignusageuom is null
                                    select @sDesignusageuom = odc_designusageuom
                                    FROM   r5objdesignconsumption
                                    WHERE  odc_object     = @sObject
                                    AND    odc_object_org = @sObject_org
                                    AND    odc_commodity  = @sCommodity
                                    AND    @dDate BETWEEN odc_fromdate AND odc_todate

                                update r5objactualconsumption set OAC_UPDATED = dbo.F_TRUNC_DATE( GetDate(), N'DD'),
                                                              oac_designusageuom = @sDesignusageuom
                                where OAC_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlIdentity

                                UPDATE r5utilityrates
                                SET    utr_indexed    = N'-'
                                WHERE  utr_date       = @dDate
                                AND    utr_object     = @sObject
                                AND    utr_object_org = @sObject_org
                                AND    utr_commodity  = @sCommodity
                                AND    utr_calculatedaverage = N'+'
                              end

							fetch next from c_ins_del into @nUpdatecount, @nOldUpdateCount, @nSqlIdentity, @sDesignusageuom, 
                                                           @sObject, @sObject_org, @sCommodity, @dDate
						end
					close c_ins_del
				end
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

instead of update
as

	declare @nId            		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nType          		numeric(1,0)        
	declare @sLabel         		nvarchar(20)

	declare @nUpdatecount   		numeric(38,0)
    declare @nSqlidentity           integer       

	declare @nOldId            	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nOldType          	numeric(1,0)        
	declare @sOldLabel         	nvarchar(20)        
	declare @sOldAudituser     	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldAudittimestamp	datetime            
	declare @nOldUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)       

	declare @sDesc			nvarchar(80)
	declare @sOldDesc			nvarchar(80)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.OAT_ID,	i.OAT_TYPE,	i.OAT_LABEL,	i.OAT_AUDITUSER,	i.OAT_AUDITTIMESTAMP,
													 	i.OAT_UPDATECOUNT, i.OAT_SQLIDENTITY,i.OAT_DESC, 
													  	d.OAT_ID,	d.OAT_TYPE,	d.OAT_LABEL,	d.OAT_AUDITUSER,	d.OAT_AUDITTIMESTAMP,
													  	d.OAT_UPDATECOUNT, d.OAT_DESC
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.OAT_SQLIDENTITY = d.OAT_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nId,	@nType,	@sLabel,	@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,
										   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,@sDesc,
											@nOldId,	@nOldType,	@sOldLabel,	@sOldAudituser,	@dOldAudittimestamp,
											@nOldUpdatecount,@sOldDesc
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
                            set @dAudittimestamp = Getdate()

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5OPVARATTRIBUTES set	OAT_ID              =  @nId,	OAT_TYPE            =  @nType,	OAT_LABEL           =  @sLabel,
						                        	OAT_AUDITUSER       =  @sAudituser,	OAT_AUDITTIMESTAMP  =  @dAudittimestamp,	OAT_UPDATECOUNT     =  @nUpdatecount, 
						                        	OAT_DESC = @sDesc, OAT_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						                        
						where OAT_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nId,	@nType,	@sLabel,	@sAudituser,	@dAudittimestamp,
										   	@nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,@sDesc,
											@nOldId,	@nOldType,	@sOldLabel,	@sOldAudituser,	@dOldAudittimestamp,
											@nOldUpdatecount,@sOldDesc
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

create trigger preupd_och
on R5OPCHARTS
instead of update
as
	declare @sSysUser				nvarchar(38)
	declare @nId            		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nReportid      		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nChartnum      		numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sName         			nvarchar(120)       
	declare @sAudituser     		nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dAudittimestamp		datetime            
	declare @nUpdatecount   		numeric(38,0)  
	declare @nServer				numeric(1,0)     
	declare @nSqlidentity   		integer             

	declare @nOldId            	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nOldReportid      	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @nOldChartnum      	numeric(38,0)       
	declare @sOldName         	nvarchar(120)       
	declare @sOldAudituser     	nvarchar(255)       
	declare @dOldAudittimestamp	datetime            
	declare @nOldServer			numeric(1,0)     
	declare @nOldUpdatecount   	numeric(38,0)       

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.OCH_ID,	i.OCH_REPORTID,	i.OCH_CHARTNUM,	i.OCH_NAME,	i.OCH_AUDITUSER,
													 	i.OCH_AUDITTIMESTAMP,	i.OCH_SERVER, i.OCH_UPDATECOUNT,	i.OCH_SQLIDENTITY,
													  	d.OCH_ID,	d.OCH_REPORTID,	d.OCH_CHARTNUM,	d.OCH_NAME,	d.OCH_AUDITUSER,
													  	d.OCH_AUDITTIMESTAMP,	d.OCH_SERVER, d.OCH_UPDATECOUNT
													from inserted i, deleted d
													where i.OCH_SQLIDENTITY = d.OCH_SQLIDENTITY
			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del
			fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nId,	@nReportid,	@nChartnum,	@sName,	@sAudituser,
										   	@dAudittimestamp,	@nServer, @nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
											@nOldId,	@nOldReportid,	@nOldChartnum,	@sOldName,	@sOldAudituser, 
											@dOldAudittimestamp,	@nOldServer, @nOldUpdatecount
			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
				begin
					if @sSysUser <> N'SYS'
						begin
							set @dAudittimestamp = getdate()

							if isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1 ) = isnull( @nOldUpdatecount, -1 )
								set @nUpdatecount = isnull( @nUpdatecount, -1) + 1 
							else
								begin
									close c_ins_del
									deallocate c_ins_del
									execute O7RAE N'UPDCOUNT', N'TRIG', N'1', @@ERROR
									rollback transaction
									return
								end

						end
					update R5OPCHARTS set	OCH_ID              =  @nId,	OCH_REPORTID        =  @nReportid,	OCH_CHARTNUM        =  @nChartnum,
						                 	OCH_NAME           =  @sName,	OCH_AUDITUSER       =  @sAudituser,	OCH_AUDITTIMESTAMP  =  @dAudittimestamp,
											OCH_SERVER = @nServer, OCH_UPDATECOUNT     =  @nUpdatecount, OCH_LASTSAVED = getdate()
						where OCH_SQLIDENTITY = @nSqlidentity

					fetch next from c_ins_del into 	@nId,	@nReportid,	@nChartnum,	@sName,	@sAudituser,
												   	@dAudittimestamp,	@nServer, @nUpdatecount,	@nSqlidentity,
													@nOldId,	@nOldReportid,	@nOldChartnum,	@sOldName,	@sOldAudituser,
													@dOldAudittimestamp,	@nOldServer, @nOldUpdatecount
				end
			close c_ins_del
			deallocate c_ins_del
		end

	declare @sOldAudituser     	nvarchar(255)

	if @@ROWCOUNT > 0
		begin
			SET NOCOUNT ON
			declare c_ins_del cursor local for select	i.ODT_ID,	i.ODT_VARID,	i.ODT_DATESTAMP,	i.ODT_ATTR1NUM,	i.ODT_ATTR1TEXT,
													  	i.ODT_ATTR2NUM,	i.ODT_ATTR2TEXT,	i.ODT_ATTR3NUM,	i.ODT_ATTR3TEXT,	i.ODT_ATTR4NUM,

													  	d.ODT_ATTR4TEXT,	d.ODT_ATTR5NUM,	d.ODT_ATTR5TEXT,	d.ODT_ATTR6NUM,	d.ODT_ATTR6TEXT,
													  	d.ODT_NUMVALUE,	d.ODT_TEXTVALUE,	d.ODT_FORCED,	d.ODT_AUDITUSER,	d.ODT_AUDITTIMESTAMP,
													  	d.ODT_UPDATECOUNT

			set @sSysUser = dbo.O7GTSUSR()
			open c_ins_del

			while @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
